en.description:
Hey. I think you know where you have to go. I will stay here, I will watch her, them, everyone. I'll be waiting for you to get answers and come back to us. Whatever happens in that year, whatever makes it so important, figure it out. 

Okay, I guess you should really get going. 

Please find him. 

- Operator

P.S i don't know how to prove it, but it really is me, not… it. Remember our meal on the Zariman?

zh.description:
嘿。我想你知道你得去哪里。我会留在这里，我会看着她，看着他们，看着每个人。我会等你得到答案然后回来找我们。无论那一年发生了什么，无论它有多重要，都要弄清楚。

好吧，我想你真的应该走了。

请找到他。

- 指挥官

备注：我不知道如何证明，但写下这条消息的确实是我，而不是……它。还记得我们在扎里曼号上吃的饭吗？

en.description:
Well met, indeed!

For completing my mini-adventure most foul, I bequeath unto thee this art most wonderful. Go forth, do with it what thou will! Adorn thine space with its colours, should ye find it suitable.

(AKA: IDK, it's cool, tape it to your wall or something.)

- Your Most Honorable Fablemaster

(PS: Still sorry about the whole… YEEeeeaAaaaah…)
en.name: WELL MET, ADVENTURER!

zh.description:
确实，幸会！ 

鉴于你已完成我这场邪恶的小小冒险，我特意将这幅绝妙之作送给你。拿去吧，随你处置！若是合适，便用它的色彩装点你的居所吧。 

（也就是说：我不造，反正挺酷的，拿胶带贴墙上之类的吧。） 

——你最尊贵的寓言主持人 

（对了：关于那整件……呀啊啊啊啊啊啊，还是很抱歉。）
zh.name: 幸会，冒险者！

en.description:
this is a top secret briefing from beckett central command

your mission, if you choose to accept it, is to rendezvous with agent amir at 00.00 PRECISELY

at which point, you MUST complete OPERATION K155 if you wish to SAVE CIVILIZATION AS WE KNOW IT…

or not, y’know… that’s cool too
<3
en.name: Operation K155 is GO GO GO

zh.description:
这是贝克特中央指挥部发出的绝密简报

如果你选择接受这个任务，就得在 00.00 时整与特工阿米尔会合

届时，如果你想拯救我们所知的文明，你必须完成 Q1nQ1n 行动……

不做也可以，你知道的……那也没关系
<3
zh.name: Q1nQ1n 行动开始

en.description:
Hiii!

It’s traditional to kiss your beloved on New Year’s Eve for luck. The Hex need all the luck they can get, so we ought to do a lot of kissing, don’t you agree?

They’re counting on us! Don’t be late!

(love you love you LOVE YOU)

Aoi
en.name: IMPORTANT!

zh.description:
嗨！

按照传统，在除夕夜亲吻心爱的人可以带来好运。六人组很需要好运，所以我们应该多亲几下，你说对吧？

他们等着我们呢！别迟到了！

（爱你爱你爱你）

碧
zh.name: 重要信息！

en.description:
Tenno,

As I adjust to the era in which I have awakened, I note with alarm the reappearance of 'Archons', a foe we have not seen since the Sentient War.

Several Archon Shards were retrieved from the battlefields. The Orokin demanded Albrecht Entrati explore the potential inherent in them, a task he immediately delegated to me.

The Necraloid has shown me some examples of Kermerros's work with Shards. Impressive. I believe I can improve upon it, however.

You may acquire the relevant Segment from the Cavia at your convenience.

Loid
en.name: Pursuant to the study of Archon Shards

zh.description:
天诺战士，

当我努力适应我所醒来的这个时代时，我惊讶地注意到"执刑官"的重现，这可是自灵煞战争以来我们再也没有见到过的敌人。

一些执刑官源力石从战场上被缴获。奥罗金命令阿尔布雷希特·英择谛去研究它们的内在潜能，而他迅速地把这个任务分派给了我。

殁世械灵向我展示了克梅罗斯对源力石的一些应用。令人印象非常深刻。但我相信我可以进一步完善它。

你可以在方便的时候从科维兽那里获取相关模块。

洛德
zh.name: 基于执刑官源力石的研究成果

en.description:
Hey.

You changed my life forever, in the best of ways. I still can't believe you and I found each other.

Here's to seeing in the New Year together, and the promise of many more to come.

With all my love, 

your Arthur.
en.name: Happy New Year, darling.

zh.description:
嘿。 

你以最美好的方式永远改变了我的生活。我仍然不敢相信你我找到了彼此。 

让我们一起迎接新年，并期待未来还有更多美好时光。 

带着我全部的爱， 

你的亚瑟。
zh.name: 新年快乐，亲爱的。

en.description:
Drifter,

Entrati had backup plans, and four of them just came knocking. Now that the old Round Table bar’s opened its doors again, we can afford to be hospitable. 

Hendricks and Volkov seem to know what they’re doing, at least. I’ve always respected the Libertatian military, even if they do tend to show up late to the party. 

I don’t even know where to start with the smart-arse kid and the rock prophet, though. 

Once I'm satisfied that we're secure enough here, I may well ask you to handle them.

Arthur
en.name: Newcomers

zh.description:
漂泊者，

英择谛有备用计划，其中四个刚刚来敲门。现在老圆桌酒吧又开门了，我们可以热情款待他们了。 

至少亨德里克斯和沃尔科夫似乎知道他们在做什么。就算自由军总是在派对中迟到，我还是挺尊敬他们的。 

不过，我实在是不知道该怎么应付这个自作聪明的小屁孩和摇滚先知。 

一旦我确保我们这里足够安全，我可能会让你来搞定他们。

亚瑟
zh.name: 新来者

en.description:
HEEYYY look at you!! Congrats on beating caliber chicks!! here's some cool prizes for your efforts. what's an arcade without prizes, right?! *SO SHINY* lol

-the l33t arcade master himself AMIR

PS: don't even think about coming for my top score, that takes like AT LEAST five loops of the game to do and that top score IS ALL MINE DO YOU HEAR ME?! MINE!!
en.name: CONGRATS ON BEATING CALIBER CHICKS!!

zh.description:
嘿嘿，看看你！！恭喜你打通了《火力女兵》！！这有一些超酷的奖品，奖励你付出的努力。没有奖品的游戏厅算什么地方，对吧？！*好闪啊*，哈哈

-顶尖街机高手本人阿米尔

PS：别想挑战我的高分，那分得至少得玩五轮才能达到，而且那个最高分全都是我的，明白了吗？！是我的！！
zh.name: 恭喜你打通了《火力女兵》！！

en.description:
WHOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA. you beat Ollie's Crash Course in 1:30?!?!?!?!

pretty soon you won't need a bike either lmao

here's your AWESOME L3WT, you l33t I-I4XXX0|2, you

-a (super impressed) AMIR
en.name: NYRROOOOOOOOOOM!!! LOOK AT YOU GO!!

zh.description:
哇塞。你只用了 1 分 30 秒就通关《奥利的极速赛道》了？！？！？！？！

很快你可能连摩托车都不需要了，笑死

这是给你的超棒战利品，你这个 HeiKeD@Shen

——一个（超级印象深刻的）阿米尔
zh.name: 嗡——！！！看你飙的！！

en.description:
y'know when i read about the whole King Corgi thing on a caliber chicks message board I thought the whole thing was just one massive prank because I hadn't ever been able to unlock it but LOOK AT YOU!! YOU DID IT!! CONGRATS!! enjoy the shiny L3WT!

... I'm not jealous at all... nope... not in the slightest...

-a (okay very jealous) AMIR
en.name: WHOA!! YOU ACTUALLY DID IT!

zh.description:
你知道吗，当我在《火力女兵》论坛上看到整个金·柯基的事情时，我还以为那只是一个大恶搞，因为我一直解锁不了它，结果看看你！！你做到了！！恭喜！！好好享受那个闪亮的奖励吧！

……我一点都不嫉妒……不嫉妒……一点也不……

-一个（其实超嫉妒的）阿米尔
zh.name: 哇哦！！你真的做到了！

en.description:
Tenno, the Warframe Qorvex was designed by my Albrecht's own hand, to protect the chosen Operator from the hazards of his laboratory. This design is yours by right.

I intend to keep the promise I made to him. When the time is right and the equipment repaired, I will assist you to travel back to the past, to the pivotal year of 1999. 

Perhaps, between us, we may change history.

Loid
en.name: For the Tenno

zh.description:
天诺战士，辐能堡垒战甲是由我的阿尔布雷希特亲手设计的，用来保护被选中的指挥官免受他实验室的危害。这个设计理应属于你。

我打算履行我对他的承诺。一旦时机成熟，设备修复，我将协助你回到过去，回到关键的 1999 年。

也许，我们两个，可以改变历史。

洛德
zh.name: 致天诺战士

en.description:
The Syndicates need your help to complete a mission. 

Acquire Abyssal Beacons from any Syndicate enclave. 

Which Syndicate you support is entirely your choice.

|LOTUS_NAME|
en.name: SUBJECT: The Syndicates Need Help

zh.description:
集团需要你的帮助来完成任务。 

请从任意集团据点中获取深渊信标。 

你支持哪个集团完全取决于你的选择。

|LOTUS_NAME|
zh.name: 主题：集团需要帮助

en.description: Tenno. Please. The Leverian desperately needs your help. Come see me in DANTE'S LEVERIAN, as soon as possible.
en.name: I have made a tremendous mistake…

zh.description: 天诺战士。拜托了。莱弗博物馆迫切需要你的帮助。请尽快来缮写士的莱弗博物馆见我。
zh.name: 我犯了一个天大的错误……

en.description:
Drifter,

The menace of ‘NECI RUSALKA' is now contained. The tale she attempted to weave is forever sundered from the Canon. She shall fester in an apocryphal Spiral all of her own. 

We are satisfied.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
en.name: A Further Missive From His Majesty DOMINUS THRAX

zh.description:
漂泊者，

"内奇·鲁莎卡"的威胁如今已被遏制。她试图编织的故事将永远与正典隔绝。她将在她自己伪造的复眠螺旋中溃烂。 

我们很满意。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝
zh.name: 士魂大帝陛下的另一个谕令

en.description:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias ‘Drifter':

DUVIRI IS IN GRAVE PERIL. 

While you were off on your FRIVOLOUS VENTURES the Lost Island of Scholar's Landing returned, bringing with it that MENACE of the VOID of which the Scholar spoke.

That SHE-DEMON has usurped Our Throne. She must be STOPPED.

I await you on board the ‘Zariman' for a most urgent conference.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
en.name: A Missive From His Majesty DOMINUS THRAX

zh.description:
致化名为"漂泊者"的昔日叛徒和阴谋家：

双衍王境处境危急。 

在你进行那些无聊的冒险时，失落的儒临地卷土重来，带来了学者提到过的虚空威胁。

那个女恶魔篡夺了我们的王位。必须阻止她。

我在扎里曼号上等你来参加一场紧急会议。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝
zh.name: 士魂大帝陛下的谕令

en.description:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias ‘Drifter':

That profane monstrosity of which the Scholar spoke has sought to claim our throne. It wears a face and puppets a body that knows you.

We have confined it in the Apocrypha, the realm of Untold Stories, but you now have a duty to keep it there.

If it gains sufficient power, its story will supplant ours!

Seek its heretical tale, ‘The Triumph of Dust'. Sever it from the true tales of Duviri.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
en.name: A Missive From His Majesty DOMINUS THRAX

zh.description:
致化名为"漂泊者"的昔日叛徒和阴谋家：

那位学者所言的亵渎之物正企图夺取我们的王座。它戴着一张假面，操纵着一个了解你的躯体。

我们把它囚禁在伪典，那些不为人知的故事里，但你现在有责任让它留在那里。

如果它获得足够的力量，它的故事将会取代我们的！

寻找它的异端故事，"尘埃的胜利"。把它和双衍王境的真实故事分开。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝
zh.name: 士魂大帝陛下的谕令

en.description:
Hello, my darling.

I wonder: how would you feel about spending a moment or two in one another’s company around midnight tonight?

It’s tradition, after all.

I promise not to be on my best behaviour.

Love always,

E. x
en.name: A New Year’s invitation

zh.description:
你好，亲爱的。

我在想：今晚午夜时分，你愿意和我一起共度时光吗？

毕竟，这是一种传统。

我保证我不会表现得太规矩。

永远爱你，

埃.亲亲
zh.name: 新年邀约

en.description:
Tenno,

Recently, I have been plagued by strange visions of the Infestation. They are warnings from Koumei herself. I am sure of it.

Kruna metta, come see me in Cetus. Together, we can overcome a terrible fate.

Be well,
Saya
en.name: Strange Visions

zh.description:
天诺战士，

最近，我一直被关于感染者的奇怪异象所困扰。这是来自御命织姬本人发出的警告。我确信这一点。

我请求你，来希图斯找我。我们可以一起战胜这可怕的命运。

保重，
萨娅
zh.name: 奇特的异象

en.description:
FRIENDS! INVICTIANS! COUNTRY-PEOPLES! Lend me your ears!

Today on this day of… whatever-the-hell-ass loop we're in, I, your most honorable Fablemaster, am proud to announce the Grand Opening of the Dominion of Höllvandeim! 

(Previously known as the Internet Cafe upstairs.)

If thy wishes to begin a new journey into strange and mysteriously lands, venture forth and - eh - summon thy loyal servant with the - um - Enchanted Bell of Fablemastery!

…Yeah just go upstairs and ring the bell if you wanna make a character and get this party started.

Fare thee well, until we speak again!

- Fablemaster Amir
en.name: Hail, Adventurer!

zh.description:
朋友们！不败者们！还有各位乡亲父老！请听我一言！ 

在今天——这个……管它是什么鬼循环的日子里——我，你们最敬重的寓言主持人，郑重宣布：霍凡德姆王国盛大开国！ 

（以前叫楼上的网吧。） 

若诸位有意踏上一段通往奇异与神秘之地的全新旅程，便请勇敢前行，并——呃——以那……寓言主持人的魔法铃铛，召唤诸位忠诚的仆从！ 

……好吧，总之想创建角色、开始跑团的话，就上楼摇铃。 

愿诸位一路顺风，后会有期！ 

——寓言主持人 阿米尔
zh.name: 冒险者，你好！

en.description:
Hey.

Heard you been grubbing around in the Zariman's backyard. That little tinpot 'kingdom'.

Well, in my extensive downtime, I've been having thoughts about weapons. How I could upgrade 'em. Give 'em a sprinkle of Void magic. And guess what? The Void did what the Void does. Took my ideas and made them real. How about that.

So if you've picked up a... let's call it an Incarnon Genesis, why not? An Incarnon Genesis, bring it to me and I'll get it installed for ya.

Slaughter awaits.
Cavalero

PS. Yonta says I need to say this very clearly: I cannot adapt a weapon you do not own. I will need both the Incarnon Genesis AND the weapon it applies to. Understood? I am not running a charity here.
en.name: Incarnon Genesis

zh.description:
嘿。

听说你在扎里曼号的后院一通乱翻。那个小锡罐"王国"。

嗯，在大量的闲暇时光中，我一直对武器有所思考。我该如何升级它们。给它们一点虚空魔法。你猜怎么着？虚空做了虚空所做的事。把我的想法变成了现实。你觉得怎么样。

所以，如果你捡到一个……我们称之为「灵化之源」的东西，为什么不试试看呢？ 一个灵化之源，把它带给我，我会帮你安装到位。

让我们屠戮以待。
卡瓦莱罗

补充一点。扬塔说我需要说得很清楚：我无法改装你未拥有的武器。我需要灵化之源和它所适用的武器。听懂了吗？我不是在这儿开慈善机构的。
zh.name: 灵化之源

en.description:
Hey.

On behalf of all the Hex, I wanted to wish you Happy New Year. 

This place is your home, and we all consider you family. 

We're all thinking of you tonight. Especially Kalymos.

All the best, mate.

Arthur
en.name: Happy New Year from us all

zh.description:
嘿。

我代表整个六人组祝你新年快乐。 

这里是你的家，我们都把你当家人。 

今晚我们都在想你。尤其是卡利莫斯。

祝你一切顺利，伙计。

亚瑟
zh.name: 我们祝大家新年快乐

en.description:
Tenno are such arrogant, undisciplined children!

Mommy Lotus might spare the rod, but not ME! Every siphoned drop of the Old Blood makes my fortress grow stronger. Sweet, sweet Kuva!

Be on your best behavior, little one. You KNOW what you did to my sister. My Kuva Liches can make sure you get what you deserve!

Your Undying Queen
en.name: Spare the Rod

zh.description:
天诺真是一群傲慢又不守规矩的孩子！

你的莲麻麻可能会放过你，但我不会！每一滴远古之血都会让我的堡垒变得更加坚固。香香甜甜的赤毒！

小家伙，好好表现。你心里很清楚你对我姐姐做了什么。我的赤毒玄骸一定会让你自食其果！

你不朽的女王
zh.name: 不打不成器

en.description:
Hey

New year is almost here and I am alone except for my bebecitos 

Make it right

You know where to find me

Te amo, mi corazón

Your Lettie
en.name: Happy New Year

zh.description:
嘿

新年快到了，除了我的小宝贝们，我一个人 

请纠正这种情况

你知道在哪里可以找到我

我爱你，我的心肝

你的莱蒂
zh.name: 新年快乐

en.description:
Something's been nagging at me for a while. It started as a little thing, but it just wouldn't go away. How come the Temple Warframe has my name? How come they have a guitar called Lizzie, too?

Temple was my stage persona. The me I wanted to be. And Lizzie is unique. I couldn't figure it out.

Until you brought me and Lizzie together in harmony, and I finally understood.

This change that's happening in me? It can't be stopped. I'm going to transform completely one day.

And that's okay. Because the Warframe from your time - 'Temple' - it's me. One and the same. The Warframe that Ballas was too scared to build, because rebellion was built into its DNA.

You see, Drifter, I go where I'm needed. I stick it to the man in Ludston, Cemaria, Höllvania... and I know I need to do it in Pluto Terminus, too, many many years from now.

I mean, if the Technocyte Coda can survive to your time, why not me?

Kaya's helped me figure it all out. There's a comet that leaves the System and gets back just in time for the Tenno Insurrection. That's where I'll hibernate. Lizzie will make sure I don't oversleep.

When Octavia hits the beat and the drums kick in, I'll be there.

Waiting in the sky, come back to join the children of the revolution.

See you!

Flare/Temple
en.name: I Figured It Out

zh.description:
有些事情困扰我很久了。一开始只是一件小事，但我控制不住一直去想。 赤焰狂歌战甲怎么会有我的名字？他怎么也有一把叫丽兹的吉他？

 赤焰狂歌是我的舞台形象。是我想成为的那个人。而丽兹是独一无二的。这一点我无法想明白。

直到你解释了我和丽兹之间的调和关系，我才终于明白。

我身上发生的这种变化？这是不可逆的。总有一天我会彻底改变。

没关系。因为你们那个时代的战甲——" 赤焰狂歌"——就是我。一模一样。拜勒斯不敢建造这架战甲，因为反抗与叛逆刻在了他的基因中。

你看，漂泊者，我有很多地方要去。拉德斯顿、赛玛莉亚、霍瓦尼亚，这些地方都有我反抗权威的事迹……我知道，在遥远的未来，我也会在宇宙的尽头继续我的事业。

我的意思是，如果科技细胞终幕者可以存活到你的时代，为什么我不能？

卡娅帮我弄清楚了一切。有一颗彗星离开了始源星系，刚好赶在天诺战士起义之前回来。我会在那里进入冷冻舱。 丽兹会确保我不会睡过头。

当吟游歌者打出节拍，鼓声响起时，我就会归来。

从天而降，加入革命的浪潮。

再见！

弗莱尔 / 赤焰狂歌
zh.name: 我想明白了

en.description:
Mon miracle,

Thank you for showing me what I would have believed to be otherwise truly impossible. And proving to me that there is hope, even for those of us who are the most shattered.

Forever yours,
- Lyon
en.name: Relive a memory.

zh.description:
Mon miracle，

谢谢你让我看到了我原本认为根本不可能的事情。也谢谢你向我证明，即使是最破碎的人，也依然有希望。

永远爱你的，
——里昂
zh.name: 重温一段回忆。

en.description:
Mon miracle,

Thank you for showing me what I would have believed to be otherwise truly impossible. And proving to me that there is hope, even for those of us who are the most shattered.

Forever yours,
- Lyon

In recognition of your work, it is my honor to award you the Archimedean Eye Sumdali, representative of the Cosmos which gazes back at us, even as we gaze into it.

你在协助我进行深层科研项目上的努力简直令人惊叹。

以科学的名义，你们忍受了严峻的条件，挫败了最强大的敌人。

为了表彰你的工作，我很荣幸地授予你阿基米德之眼船徽，它代表着宇宙，就像我们凝视着它一样，宇宙也在回望着我们。

zh.description:

同学们，我们要去实地考察。在地球的青春峰顶与我汇合。

en.description:
Working hard, are we? Trying to stop progress? Grineer progress? That’s my progress. Might work with Vay Hek. Vay Hek might roll over but not Tyl. Not me. Not my Tubemen. We can’t have that. No. Won’t have that.

Kill my tubemen. I make more. And more. And more. How many of you to kill? I count one.
en.name: I Am Unstoppable

zh.description:
是不是太努力了？想阻止脚步？阻止克隆尼的脚步？那可是我的脚步。对付韦·海克可能有戏。韦·海克或许会被唬住，但泰尔不会。我不会。我的克隆人不会。我们不会让那发生。不。绝不会让那发生。

杀了我的克隆人。我还能制造更多。一波一波。无穷无尽。而你们？只要杀一个。

en.description: Here he is. The Terror of the Orokin: bottled up like a rich lady's bathwater. Or two-credit hooch. Do what you want with him. Prop a door open, bury him twenty feet deep. Either way, he's yours. It's up to you to make sure he never gets loose again. Hell of a day, Dreamer. Hell of a day.

zh.description: 这就是他。奥罗金人的恐惧：被装在了瓶子里，就像富婆的洗澡水，或者两块钱的烈酒，你把他怎么样都行。把门撑开，又或是把他埋到二十英尺深的地下。无论如何，他都任由你处置。你要确保他再也不会跑掉了。真是要命的一天啊，梦里人，要命的一天。

en.description:
Chosen Operator. A friendly suggestion: you could do so much more with those Melee weapons of yours. I donate my wisdom on both tool and technique. Listen well.

TENNOKAI, a fighting technique fusing Void and Beastial instinct. Raw power.  While I have never used Tennokai, I understand it perfectly. Somewhat of a mind mastery. Enough so that lost materials pertaining to Tennokai have been stored just out of my reach in the Sanctum.

Tools. Papa was not one to rest, use this segment to unlock more potential for your Arsenal. The Arcane was an art and science that Papa studied well - the convexity of my bowl a magnifying glass on his research, and now your gain.

Install this segment, acquire Melee Arcanes, find Tennokai Modules, and observe the results: the swift deletion of your foes.

天诺气解，一种融合了虚空与兽性本能的战斗技巧。原始的力量。虽然我从未使用过天诺气解，但我却对其了如指掌。某种程度上，我是个心灵大师。以至于与天诺气解相关的丢失资料被放在我够不着的圣所。

工具。爸爸是个闲不住的人，用这个模块来为你的军械库释放更多潜力。赋能是爸爸研究得很透彻的一门艺术和科学——我的鱼缸凸面是他研究的放大镜，现在成了你的收获。

安装这个模块，获取近战赋能，找到天诺气解模块，然后观察结果：迅速消灭你的敌人。

en.description:
I wanted nothing but the ease of oblivion, at first. I floated ignorant in baths of nepenthe, a second gestation. Unseeing, unspeaking. Only rarely did my brain flicker errant light across the cave-paintings still smeared on the interior of my skull. 

At sensation's edge I knew a vague silhouette of Loid crooning motherly across the watery distances, the poetry my tongue was too blackened to recite.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - The Aftermath

zh.description:
起初，我除了遗忘带来的安逸，什么也不想要。我毫无念想地漂浮在忘忧草浴中，仿佛进入了第二次孕育。不见世事，不发一言。我的脑海中偶尔会闪过游离的光线，照亮了那残留在我头骨内的洞穴壁画。 

在感知的尽头，我隐约认出了一个模糊的轮廓，那是洛德，隔水相望，如同慈母般低声吟唱。我的舌头太过污浊，无法诵出那歌谣。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 后续

en.description:
I employed a variety of Cavia in an attempt to unmake the adversary. 

The principle was straightforward enough, though in hindsight I abhor my naivete. My humanity had been unscrolled by the caustic Void and now smirked back at me across the divide, privy to all my unfettered malice and pettiness. In answer, I resolved to hurl into the Void minds that were not human. Let it parody them. The proximity of the bestial would force a humbling devolution, or so I thought.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - The Cavia

zh.description:
我用多种科维兽试图消灭对手。

这个原理足够简单，尽管事后回想起来我讨厌自己的天真。我的人性被腐蚀性的虚空揭开，而现在又隔着鸿沟对我笑，对我所有肆无忌惮的恶意和狭隘了如指掌。作为回应，我决定将非人的思想投入到虚空。让虚空去拙劣地模仿它们。野性的接近将迫使它经历一场屈辱的退化。至少我是怎么认为的。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 科维兽

en.description:
In Duviri, I woke every day to the voice of my daughter. I recoiled from this at first, feeling the sting of conscience. I could not confront, even in semblance, the woman I had abandoned. Instead I reinvented myself as a teacher, advising the child-King of the menace beyond his borders.

But as the days melted away, I came to recognize the strange cast of characters Euleria had created, and their purpose. I heard voices I had myself first conjured in the darkness of her childhood chambers, for no other reward than her delight. She had not only preserved this gift I had thought so trivial, she had made it an instrument of healing. More: a stronghold.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - Duviri

zh.description:
在双衍王境， 我每天都在我女儿的声音中醒来。起初，我因良心的责备而退缩。我无法面对我所抛弃的女儿，哪怕只是表面上的。于是我改头换面成为一位师长，告诫少年国王注意他王境之外的威胁。

但随着时光流逝，我开始认出欧拉瑞娅创造的那些古怪角色及其目的。我听到了那些声音，那是我最初在她孩童时代房间的漆黑中召唤出来的，不求任何回报，只为了她的喜悦。她不仅保留了这份我曾认为微不足道的礼物，还把它变成了一种治愈的工具。不仅如此：它还成为了一个堡垒。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 双衍王境

en.description: I went among the denizens of the plague year like a savior, my hands filled with healing. To those who volunteered, I brought more than mere health. Their bodies were primed; it needed only the Helminth infusions, brought from my own time, to work the alchemy of transformation. They have become partial Warframes, still in possession of their free will, yet enhanced, Void-attuned, capable.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - The Vessels

zh.description: 我在异变之年的居民中穿行，如同一个救世主，双手充满治愈之力。对于那些自愿者，我带去的不仅仅是健康。他们的身体已经做好了准备；只需要从我自己的时代带来的赫明斯巢体注入，就能实现转化的炼金术。他们已经成为了部分战甲，仍保有自由意志，同时得到了增强，适应虚空，能力出众。
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 承载体

en.description:
All is in readiness. Loid will do as he is bid, though his eyes silently plead with me to choose another path.


As I await my final crossing to the past, I ponder what role a scientist may play in so spiritual a matter as 'absolution'. How in the alchemy of the soul, even repentance must necessarily be a calculated task.

I will repair what I have broken, no more and no less. The scales must balance. And in such a monstrous penitence as this, I shall take no heed of the dust that may fall upon them on either side, the dust of petty lives.

The builders of old tempered their mortar with blood, to appease the most ancient of land-spirits. We should have been so wise. Yet it is not too late to learn.

The sands fall. The circuit completes. I return to the place of the beginning.

Let witless hordes bleat their disdain for every fervent plan;
The deal is done, the die is cast. I end as I began.
en.name: Albrecht's Notes - We End as we Began

zh.description:
一切已准备就绪。洛德会按照命令行事，尽管他的眼神在无声地恳求我选择另一条道路。


在我等待着最后一次穿越到过去，我在思索，一个科学家在'赦免'这样一个灵性问题上能发挥什么作用。在灵魂的炼金术中，即使是悔改也必然是一项经过计算的任务。

我将修复我所破坏的，不多也不少。天平必须保持平衡。在这样巨大的忏悔面前，我不会关心任何一边上可能落下的尘埃，那些琐碎人生的尘埃。

古代建筑师用血液混合砂浆，以安抚最古老的土地神灵。我们本应如此明智。然而，现在学习还不算晚。

沙子落下，循环闭合。我回到了一切的起点。

任由那些无知人们对每个热切计划表示轻蔑吧；
交易已成，命运已定。我出于尘土，也归于尘土
zh.name: 阿尔布雷希特的笔记 - 我出于尘土，也归于尘土

en.description: The Old War found humanity facing a technologically superior force, and their own weapons were turned against them. Melee and ballistic weapons, inspired by primitive counterparts, became part of the Tenno arsenal to circumvent the Sentient interference of more technologically-involved weaponry.
en.name: Archaic Weapons

zh.description: 远古之战中人类发现敌对力量拥有科技的优势，而人类的武器被用来反噬自己。受到原始武器的启发，近战与弹道武器被纳入了天诺战士的武器库之中，来避开灵煞对高科技武器的干扰作用。
zh.name: 复古武器

en.description: Ceres is the extreme example of the Grineer's utilitarian ignorance of the natural landscape. Their expanding shipyard operations pollute and shroud the planet in smog and industrial waste as they manufacture machines of war. These foundries are scattered across the Origin System, giving them near-limitless reach with their fleets.
en.name: Ceres

zh.description: 谷神星是克隆尼对自然景观的功利主义与无知体现的极端案例。当他们生产战争机器时，其不断扩增的造船事业造成了严重污染，使得整座星球笼罩在一片废气之中。这些铸造厂四散于始源星系，使他们的舰队有着近乎无止尽的拓展空间。
zh.name: 谷神星

en.description: While the major warring factions combat each other across the Origin System, non-militant organizations and civilian merchants populate the many regional Tenno Relays. Travelling merchant collectors that offer rare goods, mentors that offer training and knowledge, and convictional syndicates that preach their own rituals and doctrine.
en.name: Citizens

zh.description: 当几个主要的交战派系在始源星系中彼此交火争战之际，非军方组织与民间商人汇集到众多地区性的天诺中继站中。这些移民中有着出售稀世珍宝的旅行贸易收藏家、提供训练与知识的导师们，也有宣扬自己仪式与教义的信仰集团。
zh.name: 平民

en.description: Predominantly a merchant guild, Corpus labour and security forces are composed mostly of purpose-bred humanoid crewmen, and animal-like robots; both equally indoctrinated into a ritualized and propagandist devotion to labour and work.
en.name: Corpus Crew

zh.description: 主体为一个商人公会，为求温饱的人类船员、类动物形态的机器人所组成了劳动力与保安部队。而两者皆被程序化洗脑，宣扬着献身于劳务和工作的理念。
zh.name: 科普斯船员

en.description: Lead by innovatory and elusive industrialists, and claiming to be descendants of Orokin lineage, the Corpus are dedicated to the accumulation of wealth. This elite ruling class operates an insular trade organization using humans and robotics for labour and security, and have been condemned by the Seven as a merchant cult.
en.name: Corpus

zh.description: 由一群创新且难以捉模的企业家们所领导，他们自认是奥罗金血脉的后裔，并致力于累积财富。这个精英统治阶级利用人类与机器人提供劳力与安全防护，运作着一个独立的贸易组织。这个组织因此被七人众定罪为商业邪教。
zh.name: 科普斯商会

en.description:
Day after day we toiled, my father, my brother Cladius, pulling grains for the Orokin takers in the city, as our kind had done for generations. We were young but the work made us old. Our backs ached, our hands bled, the sun tortured our skin. In the worst times, it felt as though death would claim us before the day was through. It was on one such afternoon that I was fated to first hear that glorious sound. A whisper I strained to hear. In a tongue not of man, but of something… else. Something... grander. A language I understood instinctively. The language of Desire. It said:

"Fear not poverty. Poverty is the bitter soil in which sweet desire blossoms."
en.name: Humble Beginnings

zh.description:
我们曾日复一日地辛苦劳作。和我族先辈一样，我的父亲和我的兄长克劳迪斯需要为城中的奥罗金获利者运送粮食，以此来谋生。那时我们都还年轻，但繁重的劳动却令我们疲惫不堪。我们每日都要忍着腰酸背痛劳作，双手时常被磨出鲜血，烈日也炙烤着皮肤。在最糟糕的日子里，我们甚至感觉活不到明天，死亡似乎随时会降临。就在这样的一个下午，像是命中注定一般，我听到了一个悦耳的声音。那是我必须竖起耳朵才能听到的声音。那不是人类的语言，而是……另一种语言。另一种……更高级的语言。一种我可以本能地理解的语言。欲望的语言。它说：

"千万不要畏惧贫穷。在贫穷这块苦涩的土地上，会开出甜蜜的欲望之花。"
zh.name: 生于微末

en.description:
The more we toiled the more impatient I grew. A fire raged inside me. I wanted more. I deserved more.

But how? The whisper washed over me, louder now than before:

"Fortune despises the idle man. Stasis is death. Always move forward."

And so, with only the whisper to guide me, I straightened my back, wiped the dirt from my hands, and left.
en.name: To The City

zh.description:
当我们付出的劳动越多，我就越觉得恼火。有一团熊熊怒火在我心中肆虐。我想要更多。我理应得到更多。

但该怎么做才行？就在这时，我听到了一个更响亮的声音，一直在我心中回荡不去：

"财富不会眷顾安于现状的人。停滞不前意味着死亡。必须永远向前迈进。"

就这样，在这个声音的指引下，我挺直了腰板，擦掉了手上的泥土，离开了那里。
zh.name: 前往城市

en.description:
The city. Those towers. I was struck with awe. What glorious totems of greed these Orokin had built. Built on. Our. Backs. Their wealth was my wealth. I was starved, while our masters were fat. and full. and warm. They flaunted their wealth, left it sitting there for the taking: priceless gemstones decorating the tower gates. I was afraid, but the whisper gave me courage.

"Be envious. Covet. Then take what you desire."

So, that is what I did.
en.name: What Right Do They Have?

zh.description:
这个城市。那些高塔。那些雄伟的建筑令我感到震撼，使我充满了敬畏之情。辉煌的图腾代表了奥罗金人的贪婪。他们建造了这些图腾。建在了、我们的、背上！他们的财富就是我的财富。我食不果腹、饥肠辘辘，而他们却酒足饭饱、脑满肠肥。他们用珍贵的宝石装饰着高塔的大门，以此来炫耀着自己的财富，就这样把财富放在那里任人拿取。我非常恐惧，但那声音给了我勇气。

"去嫉妒吧。去觊觎吧。然后夺取你渴望的东西。"

所以，我就这么做了。
zh.name: 他们凭什么？

en.description:
I was brash and bold. I struck at midday. I cried, "I take what I am owed!" as I ripped jewels from their tower gates and ran.

I did not get far.

For my blasphemy they dragged me to the tower square, throwing me to the ground in front of the sneering crowd of Orokin servants that mingled there.

The guards held aloft my satchel, containing the proof of my crime. I grasped at it, determined to reclaim what was mine. He snatched my arm, held me high and... with a dash of his plasma dagger... severed my left hand. The crowd jeered. Yet, I felt no pain, only clarity, for the whisper was with me again. It said:

"Deception is the sword of wisdom. Be wise."

They took my hand that day, but they did not take what I had earned.
en.name: The Taking

zh.description:
我自以为是、无所畏惧。就在一天中午，我终于动手了。我一边哭喊着"我要夺回来，这是他们欠我的！"，一边把宝石从高塔的大门上拽下来，开始奔跑。

可我没能逃脱。

因为我对奥罗金人不敬，所以他们将我拖到了高塔广场。我被他们扔到了地上，扔在了嘲讽的人群面前。在那里围着的都是来往的奥罗金仆人们。

那些守卫把我的背包高高举起，那里面装着我犯罪的证据。我抓着它，坚决不让他们夺走已经属于我的东西。一名守卫一把抓住了我的手臂，把我高高拎起来，然后……用他的等离子匕首……一下子砍掉了我的左手。人群中发出了一片哄笑。然而，我并未感到一丝痛苦，只觉得神识清明。因为我又听到了那声耳语，它说：

"欺骗乃是智慧之剑。学聪明点。"

那天，他们夺走了我的左手，但没能夺走我拿到的东西。
zh.name: 巧取豪夺

en.description:
I crawled back to the fields, where I collapsed before my father and my brother. I was so near death they read my Nava rites. My brother Cladius bemoaned me as a fool. How could I have abandoned them? Guilt washed over me. I asked the whisper, was he right? And the whisper replied:

"Beware the idle man who would lull you back to idleness."

Hearing this, I felt the life force stream back into me.
I sat up. They protested. I stood and they tried to pull me down. I was too strong. There was now a fire in my chest that would not be denied.
en.name: Crawling Back

zh.description:
我一路爬回了过去干苦力的那个田野，在父亲和兄长的面前昏了过去。将死之际，他们为我念了临终祷告。哥哥克劳迪斯向我哀叹，说我是个傻瓜，说我怎么能够抛弃他们呢？我满心愧疚。我问那个声音，哥哥他说的对吗？那声音回答说：

"小心那些不求改变的人，他们会麻痹你，让你重新安于现状。"

听到这话，我感觉到生命力又重新流回我的体内。
我想要坐起来。可他们却不让我起来。我想要站起来，可他们又试图拉我躺下。但那一刻，我感觉自己充满了力量。我的胸中又燃起了一把熊熊烈火。
zh.name: 落魄归去

en.description:
Moving swiftly from sick-bed to field, I fell to my knees beneath that relentless sun, my chest afire. As it moved to my throat, robbing me of breath, certain death had finally found me, I made one last heave.

I spat it out: a molten red gemstone of the purest, clearest rubedo.

Swallowing that stone would have killed a man of weaker will, but not a man sustained by the power of Desire.

It was worth more than my family had made in ten generations. It would fetch enough to feed us all for a lifetime. As I stared into its brilliant facets, a familiar voice rushed through me.

"Contentment is idleness. Desire inspires action. Nurture all desires."

And so, with my brother and father pleading for my return. I once again left for the city.
en.name: The Gemstone

zh.description:
我跳下病床，跑到田里，跪倒在那无情的烈日下，胸口火辣辣的。当这股火辣辣的感觉转移到我的喉咙时，我甚至无法呼吸。就在我感觉快要窒息时，我挣扎着呕了出来。

然后吐出了一颗炙热的红宝石，那是一颗最纯净、最赤诚的赤晶石。

吞下那块石头足以杀死一个意志薄弱之人，但它杀不死一个被欲望之力所支配的人。

这块石头比我们家族积累十代的财产都要值钱。它足以满足我们所有人一辈子的吃穿用度。当我凝视着它璀璨的表面时，一个熟悉的声音突然在我脑海中响起：

"安于现状就是懒惰。只有欲望才会激发行动。任何欲望都不应该被束缚。"

于是，在哥哥和父亲盼望我回家的恳求声中。我再一次离开，前往那座城市。
zh.name: 智慧结晶

en.description:
In desire I was wealthy, but in strategy I was empty-handed. I listened for the whisper, it said:

"Money begets money."

With my jewel as collateral, I secured a loan. And with that sum, I gave my own loans. To poor men, like me, who desired more. With each loan, I dispensed truths I had learned from the whisper. Those men went out into the world, and they too made loans, and their money too begat money. Word spread fast. Men flocked to hear me. I told them of the evils of contentment and idleness. I taught them the gift of Desire.
en.name: A New Beginning

zh.description:
只可惜我空有满腹热血，面对前路时却茫然不知所措。就在这时，我听到那个熟悉的声音告诉我：

"金钱能孕育金钱。"

于是我抵押了宝石，获得了一笔贷款。然后我用这笔钱放贷。我把钱借给像我一样充满欲望的穷人。每次放贷的时候，我都会把那个声音告诉过我的真理再教授给他们。这些人见识到了更广阔的世界，他们也学会了放贷，学会了如何以钱生钱。之后，这个消息不胫而走。人们纷纷前来向我求教。我告诉他们满足现状和不思进取的害处。教授他们欲望所带来的好处。
zh.name: 璀璨新生

en.description:
In time my money multiplied into multitudes. With this wealth, I made my body whole again.

Then news came: father had collapsed in the field. I rushed back to my family's humble farm to be by his side, but his death was sudden. Cladius mourned. But I was committed to ending the brutal labor my family and people had endured for generations. The whisper approved, it said:

"Charity is power. More charity is more power."
en.name: Giving Back

zh.description:
自此我的钱财也随着时间成倍地增加。这笔财富弥补了我肢体上的残缺。

不久之后，传来了父亲倒在田间的消息。我匆忙赶回家里简陋的农场，想要陪在他的身边，只可惜他去世得太过突然。克劳迪斯悲痛不已。于是，我下定决心，发誓要让我的家庭和我族人民摆脱世世代代所忍受的劳动之苦。此时，那个声音赞同地说道：

"施舍就是力量。施舍得越多，力量也就越强。"
zh.name: 施恩谋报

en.description:
Cladius begged me to stop my mega-dozers, "If you build a city on these fields what will we eat?" To which I replied, "Just as I consumed the gemstone that fed my fortune, our people will eat the wealth I have bestowed upon them."

"What of our home?" he cried, "Our traditions?" I pondered this until the whisper gave me the words:

"Shun sentimentality. It is a weakness that binds the idle man."
en.name: Bury The Past

zh.description:
克劳迪斯央求我，想让我的那些巨型推土机停工，"如果你把城市建在这些田地上，我们将来吃什么呢？"我回答道，"就像我抵押了宝石，增加了我的财富，我们的人民也可以凭借着我施舍他们的财富，购买足够的食物。"

"那我们的家怎么办？"他哭喊道，"我们的传统又怎么办？"就在我想不明白这个问题的时候，那个声音对我说：

"你应该规避感情用事。只有那些安于现状的人才会为此所困。"
zh.name: 埋葬过去

en.description:
I believe my father would have smiled with pride as I smashed our family home into the dirt. It saddens me that Father did not live to see the glory of Corposium, the city I erected upon our meager land. Men of Desire will always be outnumbered by idle men, men of fear.  But small men can never hold back men of Strength, and Desire.

"Fulfill desire and others will follow."
en.name: A New Empire

zh.description:
我相信，当我把我们的家夷为平地时，父亲一定会露出自豪的笑容。但遗憾的是，父亲没能活着看到我将荒芜的科普斯辛改建成一座城市。充满欲望的人总是少于那些安于现状、受恐惧支配的人。但是，对于有权势有欲望的人来说，庸人永远不会成为他们的绊脚石。

"如果你能满足欲望，其他人必将追随于你。"
zh.name: 帝国崛起

en.description:
My gift to the future is an idea; an idea that wealth need not settle as a crust upon the upper echelons of the populace. No. Any poor grain farmer can, should he feed his Desire and apply his wisdom, take fortune for himself. The more the better. And, when men of fortune come together under great leadership, their potential is exponential.

Just as my money replaced what the Orokin took from me and made my body whole again, our collective Desire will create a new body. A body forged of fortune and unencumbered by idleness or sentimentality.

"Ours is the grasping golden hand. We are desire. We are Corpus."
en.name: We Are Corpus

zh.description:
我对未来有一个很棒的想法，那就是：能够积累财富的人，不应当只有凌驾于人民之上的上层阶级。没错，每一个辛苦耕作的贫农都有资格。只要他能够发挥才智、满足欲望，就都可以为自己积累财富。财富越多越好。而且，如果拥有财富的人们能够在伟大领袖的领导下团结起来，他们的潜力将不可限量。

正如我的财富弥补了我那只被奥罗金砍下的左手，补全了我身体上的残缺，集体的欲望也将会创造出一具新的精神实体。一具由财富铸造的、不受懒惰和情感制约的精神实体。

"我们的手是紧抓黄金的手。我们就是欲望的化身。我们是科普斯商会。"
zh.name: 我们是科普斯商会

en.description: The Grineer have reclaimed the abandoned dwellings of an ancient society which sprung up around a massive Orokin terra-forming device. Content to make use of the existing structures, Mars’ current occupants have established a base of military operations in one of the few regions that has a habitable climate moderated by Orokin technology.
en.name: Mars Settlement

zh.description: 克隆尼重启了被古老社会所遗弃的住所，这些住所兴起于一个大型的奥罗金地球化改造装置。满足于利用现有的建筑结构，火星的新占领者在一个由奥罗金科技调节气候的宜居区域建立了军事基地。
zh.name: 火星殖民地

en.description: Newly awakened, and with no permanent location to call home, Tenno warriors have aligned to construct secret temples of their own. The architecture within is distinctly Tenno in origin, but these hidden palaces of bonding, training and meditation are undeniably influenced by Orokin architecture.
en.name: Dojo

zh.description: 才刚苏醒的天诺战士们，没有能称为家的永久居所，他们必须合力建造属于自己的秘密圣殿。道场的内部架构原本具有鲜明的天诺风格。但不可否认地，这座进行联络、训练及冥想的秘密殿堂，受到了不少奥罗金建筑架构的影响。
zh.name: 道场

en.description:
I am naturally curious. I can hardly help it. And so I set this down for any that follow in my footsteps, who wonder - as I have - about our home. 

Today, Duviri is a mere scattering of islands, set about the Palace as if they had spilled forth from it. But in the dawning time, when the Kingdom was new, it was a Kingdom worthy of the name.
en.name: We Are Not What We Were

zh.description:
我天性好奇，几乎不能自已。因此，我为了那些跟随我脚步的人，为了那些像我一样，想要了解我们家园的人写下了这些话。 

今天，双衍王境只是一座座散布在王宫周围的岛屿，仿佛它们是从王宫里溢出来的。但在最开始，当王境刚成立时，它是一个名副其实的王境。
zh.name: 我们今非昔比

en.description: When Duviri came into being there were many islands whose contents were - to put it bluntly- horrific. The Execution Cyst, the Golden Hive, the Inversion Tree, Stitcher’s Gulch and the Bountiful Swamp were all notorious, but each met a natural end, engulfed by the Void. Lorn was exiled deliberately.
en.name: The Island of Lorn

zh.description: 双衍王境出现时伴随着许多岛屿，这些岛屿——坦率地说——是可怕的。"处决包囊"、"金蜂巢"、"倒置树"、"缝合机峡谷"还有"丰饶沼泽"都臭名昭著，但每一个都是自然结束，被无尽贪婪的虚空吞噬了。只有孤魂岛是被故意放逐的。
zh.name: 孤魂岛

en.description:
In all the ages of Thrax's reign, only two strangers have ever been known to come to Duviri. 

One was the monk, Teshin, who fell from the sky into the lake on the island we now call Hermit's Landing. Seemingly lifeless, he was dragged ashore by Mathila who nursed his return to health. I have never known a constitution to match his; yet unlike us, he has… deteriorated… with the passing of time.

The other stranger came far earlier in Thrax's reign, before even the Bleeding Earth.
en.name: Scholar’s Landing

zh.description:
在士魂大帝统治的所有时代当中，真要说起来，也只有两个陌生人来到过双衍王境。

一位是个叫做泰辛的僧侣，他从天而降掉进了岛上的湖中，我们现在称那里为"隐临岛"。玛蒂拉把看上去毫无生命迹象的他拖上了岸，并照料他一直到他康复。我不知道谁有哪一种体质能跟他的体质相提并论；但他和我们不同，他，随着时间的流逝，状况已经越来越差。

另一个陌生人，在士魂大帝的统治早期就在这里了，甚至要早于"大地泣血"的时代。
zh.name: 儒临地

en.description: The Necropolis Island was once one of the largest in Duviri, and the strangest. It appeared to be a sprawling burial ground, littered with gravestones, wooden crosses, sarcophagi and ornate tombs. But those who broke into these places found that there were no bodies to loot. Not a cadaver, not a skull, not even a tooth.
en.name: The Doll Mausoleum

zh.description: 大墓岛曾经是双衍王境最大的岛屿之一，也是最奇怪的岛屿之一。它似乎是一个庞大的墓地，散落着墓碑、木制十字架、石棺和华丽的坟墓。但那些胆大妄为闯入这些地方的人却发现，这里没有尸体可以掠夺。没有尸体，没有头骨，甚至连颗牙齿也没有。
zh.name: 人偶陵墓

en.description:
The island of Manipura was Duviri's vineyard. The Calaventi merchant sisterhood had villas there. Their tenant farmers raised succulent grapes to be turned into wine, which was taken as a tribute to be shared among the Dax. 

Tribute day was a great celebration in the Dax barracks, as the veiled Yaskutai would pour bowl after bowl of wine, comrades would show old wounds and tell tall tales of how they were come by, and old songs would be sung late into the night.
en.name: Manipura Island

zh.description:
宝石之岛是双衍王境的葡萄园。卡拉文蒂商人姐妹在那里拥有别墅。她们的佃农种植多汁的葡萄酿造葡萄酒，作为贡品供禁卫享用。 

进贡日在禁卫军营是一个盛大的庆祝活动，蒙着面纱的管家会一碗一碗地倒酒，战友们会露出旧伤并大谈特谈他们是怎么受伤的，并在深夜里唱着老歌。
zh.name: 宝石之岛

en.description: For Lake Verula to be lost and forgotten is a lasting bitterness to me. There was a time when it was Duviri's festival spot. On the anniversary of Thrax's coronation, the citizenry would build ceremonial floating islands. On these they would drift, sing, play music and light fragrant lanterns in honor of Thrax.
en.name: Lake Verula

zh.description: 维鲁拉湖的消失和被遗忘对我来说是一种非常漫长的痛苦。曾经有一段时间，这里是双衍王境的节日胜地。在士魂大帝的加冕周年纪念日中，国民们会建造仪式性的浮岛。他们会在上面漂浮、唱歌、演奏音乐并点亮芬芳的灯笼以纪念士魂大帝。
zh.name: 维鲁拉湖

en.description:
The island was called Cornucopia, for its fecundity. The soil, dark and rich, yielded tubers and greens that shimmered with life. Wagons laden with tribute would go tottering up to the Palace in procession. 

All this was, of course, the will of the King; for what is a kingdom without its peasants? Thus had he created the islands, and thus they remained, day after indolent day. 

Then, on a morning like any other, Farmer Hovrel drove his spade into the earth and brought up blood.
en.name: The Bleeding Earth

zh.description:
这座岛因为物产丰富被叫做丰饶岛。深色肥沃的土壤长出了闪闪发光的块茎和绿色植物。满载贡品的马车会列队摇摇晃晃地驶向王宫。 

当然，这一切都是大帝的旨意；没有农民的王境算什么？他就这样创造了这些岛屿，它们就这样日复一日地留了下来。 

然后，在一个和往常一样的早晨，农夫霍夫雷尔把他的铲子插进土里时，鲜血涌了上来。
zh.name: 流血的大地

en.description:
There was a time when the children of Duviri were educated. 

Upon the island of Academe, within its chalky caves, in rough-hewn classrooms lit by burning blue gas, sages taught them everything they would need to know. They learned of the Seven Principles, the geometries, the primords, the harmonics and resonances, the sacred stories, and most importantly, the unquestionable benignity of Dominus Thrax.

And then, not long after the Rain of Chains, the first of the Hollow Children appeared.
en.name: The Caves of Academe

zh.description:
曾经的日子里，双衍王境的孩子们是可以上学的。 

在学院岛上，有一个洞口多孔的山谷。在粉白色的洞穴里，在通过燃烧蓝色气体来照亮的简陋教室里，圣人会教给他们一切他们需要知道的关于现实的本质、七大原则、几何学、原基学、谐波和共振、神圣的故事，最重要的是，士魂大帝不容置疑的仁慈。

"锁链之雨"发生后不久，第一个空洞之子出现了。
zh.name: 学院的洞穴

en.description: How I loved the Galleria. It was an island of simple beauty, where white statues rose out of the ground as if they had grown there. They were classical in their features, masked in due propriety, each bearing an instrument or an emblem of their craft. I gave them names: the Scribe, the Scryer, the Shawzinist.
en.name: The Galleria

zh.description: 我多么喜欢艺术回廊。这是一座朴素而美丽的岛屿，白色的雕像拔地而起，就好像它们长在那里一样。他们有着古典的特征，装扮得体，每个人都佩戴着代表他们自己手艺的乐器或标志。我给他们起了名字：作家、占卜师、三线琴家。
zh.name: 艺术回廊

en.description:
In the splendid lands on this side of the Wall lives happy Mathila; and she has two children. 

She also had a husband, in her yesterdays. When I have attempted to talk to her about him she has simply frozen, like a rat before a snake. 

His name was Garmi, and he was keeper of the Seriglass Lighthouse on Watcher’s Island.
en.name: Watcher’s Island

zh.description:
在"墙"这一边的壮丽土地上，生活着幸福的玛蒂拉；她有两个孩子。 

她曾经也有一个丈夫。当我试图和她谈论他时，她只是像老鼠遇到蛇一样僵住了。 

他的名字叫加尔米，他是守望者之岛上玻璃灯塔的守护者。
zh.name: 守望者之岛

en.description:
THE FIRST THREAD

Once Upon A Time… there was a little girl. An envious little girl, who watched as the whole world had more than she did. All the nice things, all the expensive things. And so she took what she didn’t have.

And along came a spider who told her that everyone in the world would always have more than she did. But the spider said he could eat it all up for her.

But she clung to her favorite toy and filled her life with her family and told the spider to GO! AWAY!
en.name: Along Came A Spider

zh.description:
第一根蛛丝

从前……有一个小女孩。一个嫉妒的小女孩，眼睁睁地看着全世界的人都拥有得比她多，所有美好的、昂贵的东西。于是她拿走了自己没有的。

这时来了一只蜘蛛，告诉她世界上总会有人拥有得比她多。但蜘蛛说他可以为她把这一切都吃掉。

然而，她紧紧抓住自己最爱的玩具，用家人填满自己的生活，并让蜘蛛滚——开——！
zh.name: 蜘蛛来了

en.description: Earth has been long abandoned due to its toxic atmosphere. It is now overgrown with mutated jungle structures that have devoured most of the prior signs of civilization. Infestation and roaming wildlife still inhabit its surface but anything of value was stripped by scavengers generations ago.
en.name: Earth

zh.description: 地球因其剧毒大气层已被遗弃许久。如今，疯长的突变植物丛林将过过去文明的痕迹吞噬殆尽。只有感染者和四处游荡的野生动物仍居住在地表面上，但一切有价值东西都在几个世代前被拾荒者掠夺得一干二净。
zh.name: 地球

en.description: Like most living organisms, the Grineer require water to survive. Beneath Earth's towering forest canopy are rich reserves of fresh water that the Grineer have fought hard to maintain for many years. Evidence of their long-standing occupation is found among their many outposts that have been taken hold by giant roots, moss, and other layers of vegetation over time.
en.name: Earth Settlements

zh.description: 正如同大多数生物体，克隆尼也需要水才能生存。在地球那高耸的森林下方，有着克隆尼竭力保护多年的足量净水资源。有证据表明，在对地球长期的统治中，他们许多前线据点都被巨型的根茎，苔藓类植物或其他多层植被植物所侵蚀。
zh.name: 地球的环境

en.description: The site of the final battle between the Unum's champion, Gara, and the colossal Sentient that wished to claim the Tower's regenerative qualities for itself. Today the remains of the Sentient, diminished and confused, wander the Plains - seeking a cohesion the Ostrons hope it shall never find.
en.name: Plains of Eidolon

zh.description: 这里是乌努母神的战士，琉璃仕女，与妄图夺取高塔治愈能力的巨大灵煞决战的场所。如今这些灵煞的残骸已经变得衰退而混乱，在平野上徘徊——寻求再次的凝聚，而奥斯唐但愿这永远不会成真。
zh.name: 夜灵平野

en.description:
Many questions remain: what is the true history of Cetus? Who is the Unum and for how long has she been one with the living Tower? What is her relationship to the Quills and what hidden purpose do they serve? The Archivist, Onkko, preserved much of the old folklore but how much of that is true?

If there is any kind of scheme to the unfolding of things, some end-point in sight, then one thing is certain: the arrival of the Tenno in Cetus is no accident.
en.name: Ancient History

zh.description:
许多问题仍然存疑：希图斯真正的历史是如何的？谁又是乌努母神，她又与那座活着的塔共存了多久？她和夜羽的关系是如何的，而夜羽们又是为了什么样隐藏的目的而工作？档案保管人，昂克，保存了大量民俗知识，但其中又有多少是真实的？

假如说，事物的演变蕴含着阴谋，视野有着终点，那么有一件事是确定的：天诺来到希图斯绝不是偶然。
zh.name: 古老的历史

en.description:
"Khanung! Khanung! Clear Ingress Four-Two-Seven-Five! Shock charges have been affixed! Evacuate five hundred meters boomward! Prepare to make fire! Prepare to make fire!"

The Unum specifies which part of her Temple-body may be harvested, and when. In this manner her body eternally replenishes, providing her people with flesh to sell, Temple-kuva to refine and oils with which to make remarkable unguents. On occasion, nestled within the substrata of her being, a rare discovery awaits: forgotten technology. Proto-essence. Things which lure travelers from across the system, and so are a bounty for her people.
en.name: The Tower's Flesh

zh.description:
"当心！当心！清空入口4-2-7-5！冲击载荷已经附着！疏散爆破方向五百米内！准备好点火！准备好点火！"

乌努母神详细列举了她哪部分的神殿身躯可以被收割，以及何时收割。以这种方式，她的身躯可以永续地再度补充，使得她的子民有肉可以贩卖，有神殿赤毒可以精炼，有油脂可以制作非凡的药膏。偶尔，在她的基质下裹挟着稀有的发现：失落的科技。原初精华。这些东西诱惑着全星系的旅行者们，也因此成为了她的子民的宝物。
zh.name: 塔内的肉

en.description:
Swazdo-lah - a common greeting
Sho-lah - 'farewell'
Surah - 'friend'
Dah-dap - 'thank-you'
Ai yo - a common exclamation. Could be thought of as 'oh my'
Lok heb - 'hail'
Chut! - 'silence!' (request for)
Kruna metta - an imploration. 'please'.
Khanung! - a warning
Utz - a universal emphatic, appended to the end of a descriptor ("I am happy utz.") 'Very'
Doh-ga - Urgency. 'hurry'
en.name: Ostron Patois

zh.description:
Swazdo-lah - 常用问候语
Sho-lah - "再见"
Surah - "朋友"
Dah-dap - "谢谢你"
Ai yo - 常用惊叹词。可以被理解为"（哎呦，）我的天呐"
Lok heb - "打招呼"
Chut！- "安静！"（征求语气）
Kruna metta - 表示恳求。"请"。
Khanung！- 表示警告。
Utz - 表示通用的语气加强，置于形容词之后。（"我高兴 utz"。）"非常"
Doh-ga - 表示紧急。"赶快"
zh.name: 奥斯唐的俚语

en.description:
The Unum gives of herself, decreeing what parts of her Temple-body may be harvested for the good of Cetus. Drillers, climbing great scaffolds, punch cavities into the Temple wall which are then packed with mighty shock charges. The call ‘prepare to make fire!' echoes across the rooftops, and all know to clear the streets and alleys boomward of the harvest. The detonations rupture the sacred flesh, freeing great blanketpieces which are, in turn, pulled free and rolled down via the use of long billhooks. It is then the duty of agile balloon drop-drivers to deliver this bounty to the butchers below.

Flensers: those who carve up the Temple's flesh.

Eruptors: those who lay shock charges along chosen lines, and ‘make fire', loosening the carved flesh for removal by balloon.

Retrievers: those who wring all oil from scrubs at the end of a shift.
en.name: Tools of Harvest

zh.description:
乌努母神献出了自己，决定了她哪部分的神殿身躯是可以为了希图斯而收割的。钻工们爬上巨大的脚手架，把神殿的墙壁凿除孔洞，然后在其中填满强力的冲击载荷。"准备好点火！"的呼号响彻屋顶，所有人都知道要撤出爆破方向的街道和小巷。爆炸物割开了神圣的肉，使得大块毯状的肉松动，随后被钩镰拉扯下，并滚落。接下来就是灵巧的气球空投手的工作，将这份宝物送到下方的屠户手中。

剥皮手：这些人切开神殿的肉。

爆破手：这些人将冲击载荷安置在选好的线路上，并且"点火"，使得切开的肉松动，好让气球挪走。

回收手：这些人负责在每一班结束时拧出所有的油脂。
zh.name: 收割工具

en.description: Perhaps it is a by-product of the Sentient's body being scattered across the Plains. It may be that the Tower is here for this very reason. Or, perhaps, it's just chance… but the Plains are mineral- and resource-rich. So much so that the Grineer risk Ostron retaliation, the wrath of the Tenno and the rage of the Eidolon itself to mine this place.
en.name: Grineer Excavations

zh.description: 也许这是灵煞的身躯四散在平野的副产品。也许这可能是高塔坐落在这里的原因。或者，也许，只是巧合……但是平野有着丰富的矿物和资源。因此冒着被奥斯唐人报复、激怒天诺和惹怒夜灵的风险，克隆尼在这里进行着采矿。
zh.name: 克隆尼的挖掘

en.description: The Eidolon is no common beast of the Plains, and cannot be laid low with the tools of an everyday hunter. These ‘amps' focus the user's will into a killing beam, capable of eventually bringing one of these giant monstrosities down.
en.name: Amps

zh.description: 夜灵并非平野中一般的野兽，寻常猎人的工具难以使其屈服。这些"增幅器"，能将操控者的意志聚焦成致命的光束，最终得以将这种庞然大物击倒。
zh.name: 增幅器

en.description:
Secretive and respected, the Quills are the Unum's closest adherents. Strange and reserved, their bond to her and each other makes for a strange relationship with causality. 

"We are each one viewpoint within the myriad that comprises the Unum. We watch, we anticipate, we intercede."
en.name: The Quills of Cetus

zh.description:
行事隐秘而又备受尊重，夜羽是乌努母神最亲密的信徒。陌生而又高冷，他们与她以及他们之间的纽带通过因果产生了一种奇特的关联。

"我们是组成乌努母神的无穷视角之一。我们监察，我们预测，我们斡旋。"
zh.name: 希图斯的夜羽

en.description:
"Attachment is pain. Whatever you wish to gain or lose is a door, behind which lies grace."

"My door is a shipment of rubedo and the cost of opening it would be...?"

"3000 credits, plus tax."
en.name: Merchants of Cetus

zh.description:
"依恋是一种痛苦。不论你希望获得什么还是失去什么都是一道门，门后则有着恩典。"

"我的门是一批红化结晶，而打开它的代价是……？"

"3000 星币，不含税。"
zh.name: 希图斯的商人

en.description: The Orokin Empire may have receded into the mists of history, but what it left behind is repurposed by those who remain.
en.name: Remnants of Orokin

zh.description: 奥罗金帝国也许早已衰退在了历史的迷雾中，但是它所留下的被存活下来的人重新地改造了。
zh.name: 奥罗金的残迹

en.description: Despatched to the Plains to assist in efforts to harness and understand the Eidolons, these shock troops stand vigil over Grineer operations. They wait for the day when the power of that lobotomized Sentient might be turned to their own ends… and loosed against the walls of Cetus.
en.name: The Grineer Tusks

zh.description: 被派向平野来协助驾驭和理解夜灵，这些突击部队监守着克隆尼的行动。他们静候着天明，在那时那些迟钝的灵煞的力量也许会有所收敛……并且被希图斯的墙所消耗。
zh.name: 克隆尼的巨牙

en.description: Finding worth in the worthless the Ostron clade-families have built for themselves a bastion from the bones of a once-great Orokin citadel. In the eyes of an Ostron everything may serve a second purpose, and what is valueless now can be turned to serve a useful purpose later.
en.name: Scavenging Way of Life

zh.description: 通过从废物中搜刮价值，奥斯唐的家族已经在这座曾经辉煌的奥罗金城堡的骨架上建立了一处堡垒。在奥斯唐人眼中，所有的东西都有其他的作用，现在无用的事物以后可以起到有益的作用。
zh.name: 拾荒的生活

en.description: The blanketpiece of temple flesh is lowered to waiting butchers and flensers. The balloon's drop-driver holds her delicate craft steady as a great airing board is positioned beneath her cargo. The Old Man gives the order: ‘Sever the mainline!'
en.name: Harvesting The Tower

zh.description: 毯状的神殿肉被下放到等待的屠户和剥皮手手中。气球空投手小心地维持着她精巧飞行器的稳定，而一块巨大的晾晒板就放在她的货物之下。一个老人发出了指令："切断主线！"
zh.name: 收割高塔

en.description: While their floating markets may ply the rails of the Origin system, Cetus is the Ostron home: a trading hub where travelers from across the system meet to exchange information, wares and plunder in safety, protected by the Unum-enforced laws of barter and parley - free from the influence of Grineer and Corpus.
en.name: Cetus

zh.description: 尽管他们的浮空市集可以定期往来于始源星系的航道，希图斯仍然是奥斯唐人的家：这是一座交易中心，全星系的旅行者在这里碰头，安全地交换信息、商品和掠夺品。这里受到乌努母神定下的交易商谈法律的保护，免受克隆尼和科普斯的影响。
zh.name: 希图斯

en.description: The Ostron mercantile scavenger culture has birthed a rich tradition of artisans fluent in many styles, able to make use of whatever material is at hand to achieve stunning results. A side-effect of Temple harvesting is a light rain of gold dust, which can lead to the degenerative condition known as ‘gilded lung'. The need for masks to protect against this has led to a rich maskwork tradition unique to Cetus.
en.name: Ostron Artisans

zh.description: 奥斯唐重商的拾荒文化促成有着丰富传统的工匠，他们善于多种风格，能够将手中任何的材料化腐朽为神奇。神殿收割的一个副作用就是产生了金色粉尘的小雨，这导致了一种退行性疾病，被称作"镀金肺"。为了预防这种疾病，对面具的需求形成了希图斯独有的面具工艺传统。
zh.name: 奥斯唐的工匠

en.description: Rising from the lakes at sundown and returning to them before dawn these simple-minded monstrosities roam the nighttime plains, howling, searching for a thing they can barely remember: completeness. Wholeness. An intelligence and malevolent purpose which, fate willing, they will never return to again.
en.name: Teralyst Eidolon

zh.description: 在落日时从湖中升起，又赶在黎明前回归，这些头脑简单的庞然大物游荡在夜晚的平野中，咆哮着搜寻依稀记得的一件事：完整性。完全性。所幸，他们再也无法回归，那种智慧和恶意。
zh.name: 夜灵兆力使

en.description:
"I know us for a miracle. A million-to-one improbability. Our existence is the most fragile of all existences. We could be exterminated tomorrow, yet we have endured by wit alone for millennia."

Oro-kin-ka: spirit houses for the souls of the Orokin who once inhabited Cetus. By giving them a small house in which to reside the Ostrons hope the Orokin spirits will leave them in peace. Said to be good luck.

Yoong-bat: Urns left outside Ostron doorways, filled with fresh water for traveling monks. No-one else should drink from them, especially offworlders.
en.name: The Ostrons

zh.description:
"我们是一个奇迹。百万分之一都未必有的可能性。我们的存在是所有的存在中最脆弱的。明天，我们就可能被消灭，然而单单凭借智慧，我们经受了数个千年。" 

Oro-kin-ka：曾经生活在希图斯的奥罗金人的灵魂居所。通过给灵魂一间小屋子住，奥斯唐人希望奥罗金的幽灵可以不来打搅。据说会带来好运。 

僧水：奥斯唐人门外的瓮，灌满了清水，给云游僧喝的。其他人不可以喝，尤其是异世者。
zh.name: 奥斯唐人

en.description: "It is my experience of the Plains that nature adapts with greater alacrity than we. Condrocs nest in Grineer comms towers, keeping watch over the gutted Sentient husks which Kuaka rodents have transformed into colony-nests. Master Teasonai has been of great assistance to my cataloguing, striving as he does to tame all manner of wildlife." - Onkko, Cetus Archivist.
en.name: Plains Animals

zh.description: "根据我在平野的经验，自然适应得远比我们要快。秃鹰会在克隆尼的通信塔上筑巢，不断注视着严重受损的灵煞躯壳，库阿卡啮齿类已经将之变成了自己的巢穴。提松奈大师对我的分类工作帮助很大，他竭尽所能地驯化了各种野生动物。"——昂克，希图斯档案保管人。
zh.name: 平野的生物

en.description:
The cry of seabirds. The delicate, permeating scent of Temple blood. The laughter of children. The shouts of merchants and hawkers. The roar of approaching spacecraft. The distant, haunting howls of the Eidolon. Cetus.

Not much ruffles an Ostron. It is as if they have made peace with whatever will be. The closeness of the Unum provides a kind of comfort, offworlders suppose. Or perhaps some of the sanguine knowingness of the enigmatic Quills have rubbed off on them.
en.name: Life In Cetus

zh.description:
海鸟的鸣叫。神殿血液弥散的轻微味道。孩童的笑语。商人和小贩的叫卖声。逼近的航天器的轰鸣。遥远而阴魂不散的夜灵咆哮。这就是希图斯。

不太有什么会触怒一个奥斯唐人。仿佛他们可以与任何东西和平共处。异世者觉得，是因为乌努母神的近临提供了一种舒适感。或者也许神秘的夜羽的一些乐观认知对他们产生了影响。
zh.name: 希图斯的生活

en.description:
"If the Unum speaks to you, traveler, it is because you have the ears to hear - though at first you may not believe it is so."

The being known by the Ostrons as ‘the Unum', and to ignorant offworlders as ‘the Wall', has a reputation for prophecy. Those wealthy enough to own moons have journeyed to Cetus, hoping to buy an audience. But the Unum has no use for wealth, and she alone decides who will hear her words, and when. 

Ostrons believe she sits at the pin-center of the universe, listening to the infinite poetry of cause-and-effect.

Some visitors to her chamber leave bitterly disappointed, others elated, others furious. But one thing is certain: the information she imparts changes the person who receives it.
en.name: The Unum

zh.description:
"如果乌努母神同你对话，旅行者，那是因为你拥有能听见的能力——虽然起初你可能不会这么认为。"

那个存在以乌努母神之名为奥斯唐所知，而无知的异世者称之为"墙"，她因为可以预知未来而名声远播。那些拥有卫星星球的富人远道而来，希望得以聆听。但是财富对于乌努母神来说没有用处，因此她自己决定何人、何时能听见她。

奥斯唐人相信她位于宇宙的中心轴上，聆听着因果的无尽诗集。

有些前去她房间的参观者离去时大为失望，有些却兴高采烈，也有些怒不可遏。但是有一件事是确定的：她所透露的信息将会改变接收到之人。
zh.name: 乌努母神

en.description: There are no longer any active military or research campaigns in the Eris region – it is overrun. Long evacuated Corpus and Grineer vessels drift aimlessly in orbit, slowly being devoured by the techno-organic parasite known as the "Infestation". What remains is a twisted graveyard of partially-digested ships that are disfigured versions of their original forms… Abandoned, but not unoccupied.
en.name: Eris

zh.description: 在阋神星上没有任何战事或研究活动－此处已被彻底蹂躏。早已撤离的科普斯和克隆尼舰船在阋神星轨道上漫无目的地漂流着，逐渐被以生物机械寄生虫而著称的"感染者"所吞噬。唯一剩下的只有被消化到一半、偏离原始外型的船舰……这里是被世人所遗弃，但却非空无一物的扭曲坟场。
zh.name: 阋神星

en.description: The icy moon of Jupiter, known as Europa, is home to one of the largest crash sites of the modern war. The scattered remains of a vast Corpus Obelisk litters the snowy landscape while the battle above wages on. On the otherwise lifeless surface, Corpus crew work to recover lost assets, tunneling their way through the glacial interior and restoring any and all salvageable items until financial losses are recouped.
en.name: Europa

zh.description: 欧罗巴，木星冰冷的卫星，这里是近代战争最大的战舰坠毁地。科普斯天碑战舰散落的残骸凌乱地遍布在雪地之上，而天空中的战斗从未停息。在这毫无生机的地表，科普斯船员努力复原损失了的财产，挖掘隧道至冰川内部，收集任何还能利用的物品，直到经济损失得以挽回为止。
zh.name: 欧罗巴

en.description: Living conditions are harsh on Europa. The surface of Jupiter's moon is flat and desolate, with a horizon of hard compacted snow that appears endless. The jagged forms of a crashed Corpus Obelisk are the only real observable landmarks above ground. Underground are caverns and tunnels of opaque ice, and crystal lakes that may have formed naturally or from the residual heat of the crashsite.
en.name: Europa Landscape

zh.description: 欧罗巴的生存条件十分严酷。这颗木星卫星的表面平坦而荒凉，远望地平线，坚硬紧实的积雪仿佛没有尽头。坠毁的科普斯天碑战舰以参差不齐的形式成为地面上唯一可见的景观。在地下则是由密不透光的寒冰构成的洞穴与隧道，夹杂其中的水晶湖也许是自然形成或是来自坠毁产生的余热。
zh.name: 欧罗巴景观环境
