en.description:
Things have never been this bad. The currents are strengthening in that rank cesspool of a Board. Nef Anyo has consolidated his power on Venus, winning Frohd Bek’s favor. All eyes are turning toward their new darling. And the currents… the currents would drag me down.  

I am underestimated. I am unseen. I must turn that to my advantage.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 1/8

zh.description:
情况从未如此严峻过。董事会那个污水坑让暗流变得更加汹涌了。奈富·安尤已经巩固了他在金星上的力量，赢得了 Frohd Bek 的青睐。所有人都把目光转向他们的新欢。而那些暗流……会让我万劫不复。

我被低估了，被忽视了。我必须利用这一点。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 1/8

en.description: I seek advantage and advantage appears! I'd long thought that old fool Regus dead, but here is - rich and gullible as ever! With an offer of shared wealth. Says he has tech like I've never seen! Old War tech. And he wants an investor. Oh, I'll invest all right…
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 2/8

zh.description: 我寻求机遇，机遇就送上门来了！我一直以为那个老傻瓜雷格斯已经死了，可瞧瞧现在——他跟以前一样有钱又容易上当受骗！他提供了一个能一起牟利的途径。他说他有我从未见过的技术！远古之战的技术，而且他想要一个投资人。哦，我会投资的……
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 2/8

en.description: This is about more than investment. Regus surprises me. How a man of his limited intellect came by such wonders is…. But… forget that. What he has is… exceptionally viable. Where did he find this technology? It stinks of Tau, but the advantages to be had in the exploitation of it… the things I could create… the profits I could accrue… the Board will never dare underestimate me again!
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 3/8

zh.description: 这不仅仅是投资的问题。雷格斯让我感到震惊。一个像他这样脑子不灵光的人是如何取得这样的奇迹的……但是……算了。他现在所拥有的技术……尽管诡异，但却可行。他是在哪里找到了这项技术？它散发着来自陶星系的恶臭，但只要合理利用，它就能让我取得优势……想想那些我能借此创造出来的东西……我能获得的利润……董事会再也不敢低估我了！
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 3/8

en.description:
Regus' price was high, but I dangled the Board's most enticing intellectual property, SysComm, to seal the deal.  Then I placed a contract, loaded with escape clauses and loopholes, in that slack, idiot's fingers… And he signed! The fool signed without even reading it!

Any partner that thick is a liability. A liability soon to be nullified.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 4/8

zh.description:
Regus 的要价很高，但是我拿出了董事会最诱人的知识产权，SysComm，作为交易筹码。随后，我起草了一份合同，里面附加了各种免责条款和漏洞，并把它交到了那个懒散的白痴手里……然后他签了名！这个笨蛋连看都没有看就签了名！

任何一个迟钝的合作伙伴都是一种负担。一种很快就会被废弃的负担。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 4/8

en.description:
Regus has changed. Or, perhaps, he is not such a fool... and today I saw beneath the mask. He is no longer so agreeable. Rather he came to our meeting with a raft of his own, radical, proposals. An entire shift in direction. And then, as I made to leave, he smiled. He smiled and, for just a second, I don't think his face was human at all. 

This is all wrong. I'm tearing up the contract. I have a terrible feeling that if do not escape this partnership immediately, I never will.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 5/8

zh.description:
雷格斯变了。或者，也许，他根本就不傻……今天我看到他面具下的真面目了。他不再那么讨人喜欢了。相反地，他来参加我们的会议时，提出了大量他自己的激进建议。整个战略方向的转变。然后，当我准备离开时，他冲我笑了。他笑了，但就在那一瞬间，我觉得他的脸根本就不像人类。

这一切都是错误。我要撕毁这份合同。有一种可怕的感觉萦绕在我的心头，如果再不立即摆脱这种合伙关系，我会永远无法脱身。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 5/8

en.description:
That was not Regus. It was never Regus. It revealed its true face to me and… by the Void. I've entered into a partnership… with Sentients. The world-builders, the world-killers. Our enemy under all. This contract is worthless. Instead, they demand submission. 

CT! Assemble the disciples. Arm the Condors. Those oversized crustaceans have no idea who they're dealing with.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 6/8

zh.description: 那不是雷格斯，它从来就不是雷格斯。它通过虚空……给我展示了它的真面目。原来……我和灵煞结成了合伙关系。那些世界的改造者，世界的毁灭者。我们所有人的劲敌。这份合同毫无价值。相反，它们要求我的服从。 终端机！召集信徒们，武装好秃鹫空投艇。让那些巨大的甲壳生物明白自己到底在跟谁打交道。
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 6/8

en.description:
That did not go as planned. Thousands against one. That massive grotesque tore through my forces like a shark through a shoal. We never inflicted so much as a scratch.

Now it perches outside my home. The message is clear. I am to make Amalgams, and if I cross them, the Ropalolyst makes an ash cloud of this city.

If my rivals find out, I'll be executed for treason. What choice do I have but to comply?
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 7/8

zh.description:
事情没能按计划进行。千军万马对付一只怪物。那个大家伙像鲨鱼穿过浅滩一样撕裂着我的部队。而我们却无法伤到它分毫。

现在，它就栖息在我的家门外。这一切所要传达的信息已经很明显了。我得开始制造并合体了，如果我反抗它们的话，蝠力使就会把这座城市变为废墟。

如果我的竞争对手们发现了我的背叛行为，那我肯定会遭到处决。可现在，我除了服从，还有什么选择呢？
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 7/8

en.description:
Disciples! Good news! The Amalgam program has entered into a fruitful partnership. Pursuant to our agreement, their identities will be kept confidential, and a strict no-fly zone shall be instated around their craft.

In time the nature of our project will be made known. Until then know that we work for a brighter Corpus future! Life is Profit.
en.name: The Partnership Fragment 8/8

zh.description: 信徒们！好消息！并合计划缔结了一段富有成效的合伙关系。根据我们的协议，他们的身份会得到保密，而他们的飞船周围也会设立严格的禁飞区。 假以时日，我们的计划终会被世人所知。在那一刻来临之前，请所有人谨记，我们是在为科普斯光明未来而奋战！生命，就是为了盈利！
zh.name: 合伙关系碎片 8/8

en.description:
The children of Cetus can often be found chasing one another through streets and around landing bays, when not helping their families with chores or the running of businesses. Traditional games are popular, such as ‘Shunta' or ‘Kubrow and Vobi'. They can be found playing riding sticks, or floating boats made from stale, hollowed-out loaves of bread. 

Since the arrival of the Tenno a new form of play has emerged, in which children act out the tales they have heard of the Tenno.
en.name: Childhood Games

zh.description: 当不需要帮家里干杂活或者照看生意的时候，希图斯的孩童们经常在街道和着陆湾中嬉戏追逐。传统的游戏非常流行，比如"Shunta"或者"库狛与沃比"。有时会看到他们骑在树枝上玩耍，或者用不新鲜的中空面包当做小船漂在水中。 自从天诺到来之后，一种新的游戏出现了，孩童们表演着听来的天诺传说。
zh.name: 儿时游戏

en.description:
The word ‘cetus', in the Ostron tongue, means ‘landless, cladeless; a body turned to dust turned to motes on a careless wind.' History says the town was founded as a home for anyone, regardless of clade, trade or origin. Friendships last a lifetime here. It is easy to imagine how, in the earliest days of Cetus - with the Eidolons roaming the Plains, the walls laid low and Grineer war parties pressing in - mutual support and protection would have been essential. 

As times have improved this trait has become a key part of Ostron culture.
en.name: Friendship

zh.description: 在奥斯唐人的语言中，"希图斯"意味着"没有土地，没有家族，随时可能在风中飘散成灰的人"。据历史所述，这座村庄建立时接纳了所有人，不论家族、职业和血统。在这里友谊长存。不难想象，在希图斯建立的早期——平野上有夜灵游荡，高墙倒伏，而克隆尼战斗部队大军压境——因此互助协防一直都是至关重要的。 随着时代的进步，这种特质已经成为了奥斯唐文化的关键。
zh.name: 友情

en.description:
What is known of the ancient warrior known as Gara comes to us from folklore and oral tradition. It is said she was the Unum's closest companion, and that when the Lotus instructed her children to flee Gara remained, refusing to leave the side of the one she loved best. 

When the Sentient was done razing a great many other Towers, when it turned its myriad eyes and receptors toward the Unum, it was Gara who gave herself to protect her friend - shattering the Sentient. The mindless monstrosities that now stride the Plains - the Teralysts - are all that remain of it.
en.name: The Glass Warrior

zh.description: 被称作琉璃仕女的古代战士因民间故事与口耳相传的传说而广为人知。据说她是乌努母神最亲密的伴侣，当莲命令她的孩子们逃离时，琉璃仕女留了下来，拒绝离开她挚爱的身边。 当那灵煞夷平了许多其他高塔时，当它将无数的眼睛和感知器探向乌努母神时，是琉璃仕女献出生命保护了她——破碎了那只灵煞。兆力使——这些无意识的怪物如今在平野上横行，则是它的的残余。
zh.name: 玻璃战士

en.description: The distant, mournful howls of the Eidolon - yearning for the terror it once was - drift through the alleys and byways, across rooftops, to the ears of sleeping families.
en.name: Night In Cetus

zh.description: 夜灵遥远悲凄的哀嚎——渴求着昔日的恐怖——流转过小巷和旁路，穿过屋顶，进入熟睡的家庭耳中。
zh.name: 希图斯的夜晚

en.description:
Chimurr: Fill the gourd with bomba leaves, then add steaming water and imbibe through a burnished juta reed. A very old Ostron tradition. To serve it to guests signifies union and friendship. 

Harpu: fresh-brewed chimurr with melted vobi butter creates a filling, tasty beverage. It is often bulked out with salt and balb flour. Always served hot. 

Daku liquor: highly sought after. The Suma Doni (a lowlands marsupial) eats the peca nut, then excretes a fine paste. It is from this paste that Ostrons make daku liquor. 

Golden caviar: harvested from abyssal depths such as the Geonate Shelf. 

Kubuchi: fermented sorghum. Cheap liquor. No Ostron would be caught drinking it in public. Any offworlder who does is immediately seen as a greenhorn and an easy mark. 

Wine: some merchants claim to be able to imbue a bottle with the ‘etheric signature' of a person one wishes to be rid of. Drink them in the evening, expel them by morning. 

Ito-da (termite droppings): Mineral-dense. Will keep a traveler going long after hunger should have dropped them.
en.name: Ostron Cuisine

zh.description:
赤穆茶：将葫芦装满 bomba 叶，再加入开水，用一根铮亮的朱塔芦苇吸着喝。这是一种非常古老的奥斯唐传统，用来招待客人以彰显团结和友谊。

Harpu：刚酿好的赤穆茶和沃比黄油一起融化，创造出一道能填饱肚子的美味饮品。常常用盐和巴柏面粉使之膨胀。永远热腾腾地上桌。

Daku 酒：非常热门。Suma Doni（一种低地有袋类）吃下芘卡胡桃，排出精细的糊。从这种糊中奥斯唐人制作出 daku 酒。

黄金鱼子酱：收获自深海的深渊，比如 Geonate 大陆架。

库布奇酒：发酵的高粱。一种廉价的酒。奥斯唐人绝对不会在公开场合喝它。任何公开喝这种酒的异世者立刻会被看做是好骗的愣头青。

葡萄酒：有些商人号称可以在瓶中注入你想要摆脱之人的"醚特征签名"。晚上灌醉那人，白天就能赶走了。

Ito-da（白蚁粪便）：富含矿物质。可以在饥饿击倒旅行者之前，让他们支撑很久。
zh.name: 奥斯唐料理

en.description: The sprawling military ranks of the Grineer empire are formed of rotting hordes of simpleton clones, bent on consuming everything that remains of the Origin System. They live short, violent lives, much of it an inheritance of their genetic stunting by their former Orokin masters.
en.name: Grineer

zh.description: 克隆尼帝国中延绵不绝的军事阶层构成了这群腐朽而低智慧的复制人军队，他们决心将始源星系的残存价值消耗殆尽。由于多数克隆尼受到过往主人奥罗金基因发展不全遗传的影响，他们的生命周期短且易骤逝。
zh.name: 克隆尼阵营

en.description:
"It came through the wall. All I remember is the roar, the open maw… the rank foulness of its breath. The lolling tongue. And… the way two of my friends were crushed between it and our grain silo. The way it seemed to fall in love with tearing them apart, over and over and over…"
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: Devourer

zh.description:
"它破墙而至。我只记得那吼声，那张开的巨颚……那带有强烈腐臭味的吐息，垂下的舌头，还有……它将我的两个朋友连同我们的粮仓一起咬碎。它一遍又一遍地撕咬，似乎非常享受将猎物撕碎的快感……"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 吞噬者

en.description:
"Its arms shot forward, the drills ratcheting outward… passing in and out of Horvath's body like it was nothing. I can still hear the screech of the drills. The maddening chatter of its teeth. Horvath's screams."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: Augur

zh.description:
"它的双臂向前弹射出去，那钻头旋转着飞出……Horvath 的身体如同薄纸一般，瞬间就被刺破。即便是现在，我依然能听到那钻头发出的啸叫声，那牙齿所发出的狂乱之语，还有 Horvath 的哀嚎。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 钻孔者

en.description:
"It came at me, wailing, like a lost thing screaming for help. Then it wrapped its clay-cold arms about me… and here I am. Barely anything left of me now, lying in this bed, except a few stories… and the memory of its face. Like a newborn child."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: The Expired

zh.description:
"它朝我过来，哀号着，如同一只正在求救的生物。随后，它用如同陶土般冰冷的手臂将我缠住……把我变成了现在这副样子。我拖着一副所剩无几的身体，躺在床上，如同一个新生儿。现在我所剩下的，只有一些故事……和关于它样貌的记忆。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 除役者

en.description:
"Konzu gave us standing orders. Shoot the sawmen first. We'd seen what they had done to our brothers and sisters. That was not going to happen to us."
Interviews in the Field, Eidolon Plains, conducted by Sigor Savah.
en.name: Rictus

zh.description:
"孔尊给我们下达了作战命令。先朝那些电锯兵射击。我们已经见识过他们对我们的兄弟姊妹所做的事。我们绝不能让那些悲剧在我们身上重演。"
采访地点：夜灵平野的野外。采访者：西格·萨瓦。
zh.name: 裂嘴者

en.description:
I came to the Eidolon Plains not to explore horror, but to lay to rest an ancient mystery. It would seem, horror had something to say, regardless.

The Ghouls. Grown in darkness, beneath the feet of the enemy. Born to fight.. To kill… and to die.

Truly, of all the places horror may call home, it is most comfortable within the imaginings of men.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Ghouls

zh.description:
我来到夜灵平野并不是为了探寻恐怖之物，而是为了解开一个上古谜团。不过，这趟旅途似乎终究无法摆脱恐怖的萦绕。

尸鬼。成长于敌人脚下的黑暗之中。生来就是为了战斗……杀戳……和死亡。

实话说，尽管恐怖之物可以出现在很多地方，但它们最喜欢的地方，还是人们的脑海。
西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 尸鬼

en.description:
The Ghouls are designed to a simple philosophy: victory assured, through overwhelming numbers and the element of surprise.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Overwhelming Numbers

zh.description:
尸鬼被设计为一种头脑简单的生物：他们只会通过人海和突袭战术来取得胜利。
西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 人海战术

en.description:
Sudden terror… the element of surprise… and cheaply bought. Ghouls are shock troops, fast-grown in diapause bags, cultured from repurposed Grineer gene slurry. The key to victory is quantity over quality. A tide of claws and flesh to crush any enemy foolish enough to stand before it.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: A Tide of Claws and Flesh

zh.description:
突现的恐怖……偷袭战术……且成本低廉。尸鬼是突击部队，他们能在休眠袋中以惊人的速度成长，通过改造过的克隆尼基因浆培育。用数量代替质量是他们的制胜理念。任何胆敢阻挡他们的对手，都会被潮水一般的利爪和血肉所粉碎。
西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 利爪与血肉之潮

en.description:
While not of Vor's design, the General uses the ghouls to good effect.

Credit for the development of these horrors goes to none other than Doctor Tengus: father of the infamously unstable Grustrag 3. Developed in his laboratories, against the wishes of Vor himself, and with the funding of a certain ill-fated Counsellor… the Ghouls are Tengus' crowning achievement. 

They have secured the Doctor's place in the good graces of the Grineer Queens.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Doctor Tengus

zh.description:
尽管尸鬼并非出自沃尔之手，但这位将军很好地运用了尸鬼的能力。

在这恐怖之物的研发过程中起到关键作用的人，自然要算 Tengus 博士——他是臭名昭彰的格鲁斯塔三霸之父。尽管沃尔反对这项研究计划，但某位命运多舛的议员却为之提供了资金支持，并最终让尸鬼的研究获得成功……尸鬼是 Tengus 所取得的最高成就。

博士也因此获得了克隆尼女皇们的嘉奖。
西格·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 天狗博士

en.description:
Ghouls are far from the finest of Grineer troops, but what they lack in martial skill they make up for in sheer horrifying volume.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Strength In Numbers

zh.description:
尸鬼远远不是克隆尼最优秀的士兵，但他们军事技能上的缺陷由绝对的恐怖数量所弥补。
西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 数量即是力量

en.description:
Ghouls are deployed in advance of regular Grineer troops. Before then, those troops must keep the ghouls sated… lest they turn upon those who failed to feed them.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Shock Troops

zh.description:
尸鬼会被部署在常规克隆尼部队之前。直到部署前，必须先满足尸鬼的口腹……以免他们倒戈攻击喂不饱他们的部队。
西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 突袭部队

en.description:
Especially degenerate Ghoul specimens are employed as suicide troops
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Born To Die

zh.description:
尤其是那些退化了的尸鬼样本，被用作敢死部队。
西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 为死而生

en.description:
They are incapable of fear. Relentless.
Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: Unstoppable

zh.description:
他们无法感到恐惧、残酷无情。
西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 无可阻挡

en.description:
Massive casualties may be inflicted upon massed ranks of ghouls without slowing their advance.

This is a new phase in the Grineer campaign for dominance in the Origin System.

One that has increased the stakes for every sentient being who calls it home.

Sigor Savah, morphologist and antiquarian.
en.name: A New Phase

zh.description:
大规模的尸鬼部队可以造成巨量的杀伤，并且他们的行进速度完全不会受到影响。

这是克隆尼阵营统治始源星系战役的全新阶段。

在这个阶段里，对于以此为家的众生而言，是更加危险了。

西格尔·萨瓦，形态学和文物学家。
zh.name: 新的阶段

en.description: Strict laws on organic engineering impose severe mental and physical health limitations on the Grineer labour force. Whatever standard human stock they were originally derived from has been lost. Compliant and high-performing variants are often technically augmented to extend their lifespans beyond the few decades they can normally expect in operation.
en.name: Grineer Labour

zh.description: 生物工程上的严酷律法在 克隆尼劳动力身上强加了心理与生理上的严重缺陷。最初这批劳力是从何而来的已经不为人知。顺从听话而又表现良好的变种往往会通过技术手段强化来延长他们的寿命，活过原本仅仅数十载的预期运行寿命。
zh.name: 克隆尼劳工

en.description: Grineer are all clones from a genetic pool of ‘Originals'. They are able to extend their lifespans with recycled cloned parts, but their genetic material has degraded over time, and haphazard repairs have made many of them look oddly deformed and susceptible to skin diseases. Through decades of service, many of the Grineer elite can cover the expense to have flawed organic parts replaced with cybernetic augmentations.
en.name: Grineer Leadership

zh.description: 克隆尼全体皆是由"原始基因"的基因库复制生产而来。他们能回收使用复制的器官部位来延长寿命，然而克隆尼基因物质的恶化程度也会与日俱增。杂乱无章的修补导致众多克隆尼的外貌产生了诡异的残缺且易受皮肤疾病的影响。在献身种族数十年后，许多克隆尼精英能负担起将缺陷部位替换成神经机械的费用。
zh.name: 克隆尼领导阶层

en.description: Unlike the Corpus, the Grineer are not celebrated for their ingenuity and craftsmanship. Their notoriety is steeped in violence and military proficiency. However, the Grineer have proven quite inventive and capable of developing their own technologies throughout history. Hiding beneath scrap metal plates, fading paint, and recycled components are qualified devices used for research, manufacturing, and warfare.
en.name: Grineer Technology

zh.description: 与科普斯不同，克隆尼并不以创新和技艺而闻名。他们的在暴力和军事能力上臭名昭著。不过纵观历史克隆尼还是体现出了一定的创造与科技发展能力。隐藏在废金属板、暗淡的涂装和回收利用的组件之下，是用来研究、制造和作战的合格设备。
zh.name: 克隆尼科技

en.description: The Infestation spreads across the Origin System – a techno-organic parasite that attaches itself to natural and synthetic forms, slowly digesting the host subject and transforming it on a molecular level. Organic materials morph into new homogeneous organisms while harder, inorganic materials, like metals, will change structurally into a pseudo-organic substance that holds the characteristics of its previous forms.
en.name: Infestation

zh.description: 这群肆虐了整座始源星系的感染者是一种生物科技的寄生体，它们将自己寄生在天然和人工合成物上，以融合的形式缓慢消化宿主，在分子级别上转化宿主。被寄生者体内的有机物质会因此异变为同质有机体，接着，无机物质将会改变结构，成为保有过去宿主特征的伪有机物。
zh.name: 感染者

en.description: Infestation of a living natural organism and the transformation of its molecular structure happens much more rapidly than with large synthetic ships or machinery. Infested nanites quickly break down organic tissue and begin to evolve the existing specimen into a new organism with characteristics and functions ideal for survival and self-defense. In many cases, visible traces of the victim's original form are still visible in the new mutated form – a stark and horrifying memorial.
en.name: Infested

zh.description: 感染者是活生生的自然有机体，在与大型综合船只或机械结合时，其分子结构的改变会发生更加快速。异变感染体纳米机器能迅速分解有机组织，再将现有的样本发展成特征与机能为最适合生存与自我防卫的新有机体。在多数情况下，被害者原有的形态变异后还能被辨认出来——聊以作为一个凄凉恐怖的纪念。
zh.name: 感染

en.description: It is not impossible to mine a star. Rich with liquid metallic resources, the gas-giant Jupiter challenges harvesters with increased gravity, intense magnetic fields, and extreme temperatures. Only the most tenacious profiteers would dare operate here. Prevailing science of Corpus industry thrives in the clouds of Jupiter’s outer atmosphere.
en.name: Jupiter

zh.description: 开采一颗星星并非不可能。巨大的气体星球木星有着丰富液态金属资源，其重力、强力磁场和极端温度，都是开采者将会面临到的挑战，只有最坚毅的投机者敢来此进行投资。科普斯工业的主流科技在木星的外层大气中茁壮成长。
zh.name: 木星

en.description: Warframe operative insertion craft come in many designs, but they are all commonly classified as short-range stealth aircraft. Fuselage insertion stingers will torpedo the Warframe into the hull of the target undetected, and the landing craft will re-position at the extraction point. Between engagements, the landing craft is latched to its sister component, an Orbiter.
en.name: Landing Craft

zh.description: 战甲特工的渗透飞行器有很多种设计，不过大多属于短距离隐身飞船。船体入侵器会将战甲神不知鬼不觉地投射到目标船体内，随后登陆艇会移动至撤离点。在作战任务之间，登陆艇与它的姐妹舰——轨道飞行器连接。
zh.name: 登陆艇

en.description: Functioning agents of the Infestation appear in a variety of horrific forms. While some infested organisms take the relative shape and physical properties of a newly acquired host, older entities have taken unique and transformative shapes of their own, adapting to their environment over time, and absorbing new victims to feed their evolution.
en.name: Lephantis

zh.description: 可活动的感染者有着各种可怖的形态。尽管一些被感染生物的形状和物理性质与新捕获的宿主大体相同，较老的个体则已经变化成了自己独有的形状，以逐渐适应环境并吸收新的被害者来促成进化。
zh.name: 雷凡魔像
西里斯&奥里昂臻藏卡牌

en.description: Guiding light to the newly-awakened Tenno, the Lotus is a mysterious companion and mentor who works from an unknown remote location. Her past is rich with storied history, and her knowledge of the known universe, past and present, rivals even the most studious Cephalon intelligence. Her reach is far, her allies are many, but her ultimate intentions are of dubious propriety.
en.name: Lotus

zh.description: 总是在远方未知之处的莲是刚醒天诺战士的引导之光，是天诺战士的神秘伙伴与指引者。她的过去是充满传奇的历史，而她对过去与当下的宇宙知识，可以匹敌最勤学的中枢智能。她的影响力十分广泛、盟友众多，但她的最终意图仍令人存疑。
zh.name: 莲

en.description: A primitive and devout civilization was carved into the dust-filled canyons of Mars. These aging and severely eroded habitations miraculously remain intact, regardless of how much Grineer machinery has been fastened to it. Rusty metal and oil-soaked sand mark the territory of its new proprietors.
en.name: Mars

zh.description: 在火星上，曾有一支原始且信仰虔诚的文明座落在遍地沙尘的峡谷当中。无论克隆尼在此设立了多少机械设施，这些老化、饱受侵蚀的前人居所奇迹般地保持了原貌，只是生锈的金属与油腻的沙子标志着这里的新主人。
zh.name: 火星

en.description: Galleon fleets keep watch over the Grineer mining operations that penetrate Mercury's asteroid field. Cavernous rooms and twisting metal corridors mark where labourers have stripped the region for crucial resources, transforming the natural landscape to support Grineer occupancy.
en.name: Mercury

zh.description: 目前克隆尼的帆船舰队正看守着贯通整个水星小行星带的采矿作业。巨穴结构的空间和扭曲的金属廊道，标志着劳工们剥开这里搜刮重要的资源，将自然景观转化为对克隆尼占领的支撑。
zh.name: 水星

en.description: Gold rings circle and encapsulate the desolate moonscape – lavish architecture signifying the Orokin mastery over all things natural and technological during their reign. The opalescent halls stitching together what the enemy destroyed have been vacated since that era came to an end.
en.name: Lua

zh.description: 金色的圆环围绕着荒凉的月球表面－奢华的建筑象征着奥罗金在统治期间内掌控了自然、技术与一切万物。自从奥罗金时代结束以后，那些连接着被摧毁区域的乳白色大厅已经空无一人。
zh.name: 月球

en.name: Lullaby of the Manifold - Adis's Lament

zh.name: 万物摇篮曲 - 阿迪斯的哀歌

en.description: The Corpus have perfected automated manufacturing and continue to demonstrate maximum efficiency producing the robotic proxies they build to serve them. Immaculate production lines and flawless technical engineering ensure that the production of robotics and intelligent, synthetic machines continues in perpetuity.
en.name: Neptune

zh.description: 科普斯拥有完美的自动化生产，并持续展现出制造自用代理机器的极致效率。洁净的生产线和完善的工程技术保证了机器人与智能综合机械的生产可以永续进行。
zh.name: 海王星

en.description: Tenno operatives are a highly mobile strike force, and their property must be equally itinerant. Smaller landing crafts dock with the larger Orbiter shuttle where transient warriors can house their arsenal, foundry, and research systems.
en.name: Orbiter

zh.description: 天诺操控者们是一股高机动性武力，他们的根据地势必居无定所。小型登陆艇停靠在更大的轨道飞行器上，在那里这群流浪战士安置了他们的军械库、铸造场与研究系统。
zh.name: 轨道飞行器

en.description: Even the most culturally and technologically advanced civilization in history could not contain the menace of the Infestation. After an unknown cataclysmic event propelled them from the Void, Orokin vessels were left adrift, becoming uninhabited and overgrown. The tireless force of probing infested tendrils penetrate and dislodge the once majestic and opulent halls of these Orokin vessels.
en.name: Orokin Derelict

zh.description: 即便是在过去历史中最具文化及先进科技的文明，也无法控制感染者造成的危害。在不明的灾难事件发生后，奥罗金退出了虚空，空无一人的船只便被遗留在虚空中任其漂流。而感染者不断滋生的探测卷须贯穿并肢解了一座座奥罗金飞船中曾经辉煌繁华的大厅。
zh.name: 奥罗金遗迹

en.description: The highly revered Orokin civilization built sovereignty on a culture of art, technology and architecture. To prove oneself worthy of elevated social status, one must face Orokin trials in the golden and majestic Halls of Ascension. At one time a utopian society of omniscient leadership, the great Orokin Era ended in a divine realization of their own ignorance.
en.name: Orokin

zh.description: 崇高的奥罗金文明立身于艺术、科技和建筑文化，打造了一个主权帝国。如欲证明自身得以匹配更高的社会地位，则必须面对金色宏伟的晋升大厅的奥罗金试炼。这个曾经在全知全能领导下的乌托邦社会，伟大的奥罗金时代最终在由自身的无知引起的神罚中宣告终结。
zh.name: 奥罗金阵营

en.description: Phobos has always been a highly contested area. Skirmishes between the tireless Grineer and Corpus factions occur in orbit and on the Martian moon surface. Unanswered questions about this natural satellite still remain as all research is endlessly delayed by war.
en.name: Phobos

zh.description: 火卫一历来是兵家必争之地。克隆尼与科普斯在火卫一的轨道和表面展开了无休止的征战。而这颗天然卫星残留着的不解之谜，其研究至今仍被战乱而无限期回柜。
zh.name: 火卫一

en.description: Weapons research and manufacturing is a large component of Corpus industry. Their designs are clean and precisely engineered, and they are the largest supplier of energy-based weapons in the Origin System. These cunning profiteers prefer to avoid conflict in times of war, dealing arms indiscriminately to any side that can afford the price.
en.name: Corpus Weapons

zh.description: 武器研究及生产是科普斯工业领域的一大部分。他们的设计十分简洁并且极其精密，同时他们还是太阳系内最大的能量武器供应商。这群狡诈的奸商更愿意在战时躲避直接交火，然后在有利益可乘之际，一视同仁地向任何付得起钱的人销售军火。
zh.name: 科普斯的武器

en.description: Pluto is small and cold, and organic tissue does not fare well in its extreme climate. But the merchant spacemen always seek opportunity for profit in regions where others dare not travel. Robotic proxies act as security in the largely un-manned manufacturing facilities that operate in the area.
en.name: Pluto

zh.description: 冥王星是气候寒冷的小型星球，有机组织在此难以生长。但是太空商人总是会在其他人不敢去的地方寻觅商机。代理机器人会在此地运作中的大型无人生产设施里担任安保要务。
zh.name: 冥王星

en.description: A vision comes, something new is stirring within the ground. Seeking a body to call its own; longing to strike those who sent it to the grave.
en.name: A New Threat Looms

zh.description: 一个影像出现了，全新的威胁在地底搅动。寻求着成为自身的身体，渴望着伏击将其送入坟墓之人。
zh.name: 新的威胁暗中蠢动

en.description: A fragment of the ancient Sentient that once terrorized these plains.
en.name: A Terror Long Forgotten

zh.description: 曾经威胁着这平野的远古灵煞的一片碎片。
zh.name: 久远遗忘的恐怖

en.description: The warden of the plains, tasked with striking down the ever-returning ghostly Eidolon that threatened the Unum's Tower. Night after night, he cut them down. Then one night, he disappeared, lost… forever.
en.name: The Lost One

zh.description: 平野的看守者，被赋予了击倒那鬼魅夜灵的任务，这只不断试图回归的夜灵曾经威胁了到了乌努母神之塔。夜复一夜，他将其击倒。但某一个晚上，他消失了，永远地……迷失了。
zh.name: 迷失者

en.description: Computing devices, weapons, ship parts and robotics – the Corpus are on the bleeding edge of high-technology development. Precisely machined metals and flexible synthetic composites are signature to the animalistic robots that the Corpus have built as their proxies. Artificial intelligence in these robotics is robust, but intentionally restricted, ensuring a capable but subservient workforce.
en.name: Robotics

zh.description: 从电脑设备、武器、船舰组件到机器人－科普斯商会总是位于最新技术发展的尖端。柔性的合成复合材料是科普斯人用以制造类兽形代理机器人的特征。这些代理机器人的人工智慧虽然非常强大，但却被刻意设下限制，为的是确保其服从性及工作能力。
zh.name: 机器人

en.description: The historically well-travelled merchant shipping lanes of Saturn are now dominated by Grineer blockades. Heavy military influence populates this area where Grineer Commanders believe they have a strategic foothold on travel throughout the System. Under the safeguard of patrolling Galleons, the Grineer ceaselessly train their expanding forces, making the region nigh impossible to overtake.
en.name: Saturn

zh.description: 土星历史上最常被利用的商业航线，现在已被克隆尼阵营封锁。整片区域皆被这支大军所影响，克隆尼指挥官相信他们已占据了星系航行的战略要点。在帆船舰队来回巡逻的保护之下，克隆尼不断训练他们的扩张武力，以致在此区域近乎无人可超越其势力。
zh.name: 土星

en.description: If there are new discoveries to make or ancient tools of war yet to be excavated, the Grineer want to be there first — at the frontier of space exploration. Always seeking the upper-hand against their foes, they have numerous deployments that border the known reaches of our Origin System, poised to enter brave new territory and unexplored space on command.
en.name: Sedna

zh.description: 若在太空探索的边境之中，还有哪里能有新的发现或挖出古老的战争工具 — 克隆尼人绝对会第一个抵达。克隆尼人总是在寻找优势攻击敌人，在我们所知的始源星系边缘，他们部署了无数的军队准备踏上新的领地，听从命令探索未知的太空。
zh.name: 赛德娜

en.description:
Things have never been this bad. The currents are strengthening in that rank cesspool of a Board. Nef Anyo has consolidated his power on Venus, winning Frohd Bek’s favor. All eyes are turning toward their new darling. And the currents… the currents would drag me down.  

I am underestimated. I am unseen. I must turn that to my advantage.

zh.description:
情况从未如此严峻过。董事会那个污水坑让暗流变得更加汹涌了。奈富·安尤已经巩固了他在金星上的力量，赢得了 Frohd Bek 的青睐。所有人都把目光转向他们的新欢。而那些暗流……会让我万劫不复。

我被低估了，被忽视了。我必须利用这一点。

en.description: On the border of charted space, an enclave of small, strange, seemingly intelligent creatures was discovered by Tenno explorers. They are mechanical entities, almost organic in appearance, with a precarious resemblance to the fearsome Sentients that had decimated human civilization. However, these small creatures showed no signs of aggression, and they immediately began carrying out helpful tasks in peculiar alliance with the Tenno.
en.name: Sentinels

zh.description: 天诺探索者在星图的边界发现了一小块似是智慧生物的奇怪内飞地。有着机械实体、近似有机的外观，与毁灭了人类文明的灵煞有危险的相似处，但是这些小型生物并未显示出侵略迹象，反而立刻与天诺战士结成奇特的联盟，执行了多项协助工作。
zh.name: 守护

en.description:
I founded Solaris United the day an old woman had her pet taken from her. The day my best friend watched her arms be given to someone else. The day my mother lost her head. 

I founded Solaris United the day I sold my heart. 

To buy a gun.
en.name: Eudico Mem Fragment 1/5

zh.description:
我创立索拉里斯联盟的日子：是一位老妇的宠物被夺走的日子；是我最好的朋友看着自己的手臂被交给了另外一个人的日子；也是我母亲失去头颅的日子。

在我创立索拉里斯联盟的那一天，我卖掉了我的心。

买来了一把枪。
zh.name: 尤迪科的记忆碎片 1/5

en.description:
Biz just appeared one day, taught us how to fight economically, intelligently. Oh… Sparky, you should have seen us. Fireballing refineries by night, dutiful clean-up crew during the day. My job was to get people believing in us. Believing we could change things.

That got more people killed than anything Zuud and her sisters could have hoped to make.
en.name: Eudico Mem Fragment 2/5

zh.description:
生意人在某天突然出现，并教会了我们如何以经济且高明的方式来战斗。噢……小火花，你真应该来看看我们那时的样子。晚上精炼炉火力全开，白天清扫人员认真工作。我的职责是让人们相信我们，相信我们能够改变现状。

但这场变革带来的伤亡，已经超越了祖德和她的姐妹们所能造出的最强武器。
zh.name: 尤迪科的记忆碎片 2/5

en.description:
It was a small operation, one we almost didn't run. That's what keeps me up at night. 

Deck 12.
en.name: Eudico Mem Fragment 3/5

zh.description:
那……那是一次小行动，一次差点让我们没能逃出来的行动，同时也是一段让我时常无法入睡的记忆。

12号甲板。
zh.name: 尤迪科的记忆碎片 3/5

en.description:
Everyone I knew, everyone who believed in us, everyone I convinced to sign on… died. Parents, lovers… families.  Zuud's sisters.  Leg's folks.  All gone.

Except us, and a few others. Me, Biz, Zuud, Little Duck. I washed my hands of it. They were bloody enough.
en.name: Eudico Mem Fragment 4/5

zh.description:
所有我认识的人，所有相信我们的人，所有我招募来的人……都死了。双亲、恋人……整个家庭。祖德的姐妹。腿哥的亲人。全都逝世了。

除了我们，还有其他一些人。我、盘总、祖德、小鸭子。自那之后，我就洗手不干了。因为我的双手上沾染了太多的鲜血。
zh.name: 尤迪科的记忆碎片 4/5

en.description:
Then, years later, Biz showed up again. And then you. And then, somehow, here we are.

This isn't the first Solaris United. It's the second. And, one way or another, the last.
en.name: Eudico Mem Fragment 5/5

zh.description:
几年之后，生意人又一次回到了这里。而后，你就来了。再之后，发生了一些事，我们就变成了现在这个样子。

这不是第一个索拉里斯联盟。这是第二个。而且，无论结果如何，这都会是最后一个。
zh.name: 尤迪科的记忆碎片 5/5

en.description: So I ain't got no fam - biological or logical. Mumsie and Dadsie got burned up workin' for Solaris United the first time. Figured I'd be a ventkid, but then the Temple came lookin' to collect on what I took from ‘em, an' left me barely a head. So, really things could only get better from there.
en.name: Legs Mem Fragment 1/5

zh.description: 我没有家人（无论是生理还是义理上）。老爸老妈在第一次为索拉里斯联盟工作时就被烧死了。后来我打算加入通风小子，可没想到润盈殿那边居然派人来索回我从他们那里偷走的东西，然后我就差不多只剩下一个头了。所以说，从今往后，我的生活只会变得更好。
zh.name: 长腿的记忆碎片 1/5

en.description:
Can't be a ventkid all MOA'd up. Don't fit, can't crawl, can't board. So I make my logical fam right here in me shop. Y'can see the resemblance. Runs in the family. 

Woulda been a ventkid, though. For sure.
en.name: Legs Mem Fragment 2/5

zh.description:
我全身都被换成了恐鸟部件，也就无法加入通风小子。因为这副身体实在是不合适，无法爬行，更无法使用悬浮板。所以我就在自己的店里制作我的义亲。你能从它们身上看到家人的影子。

当然，如果可能的话，我还是想成为通风小子。
zh.name: 长腿的记忆碎片 2/5

en.description: Mister The Business has been really good to me since… since my accident. Always comin' over with somethin'. I tell him he doesn't have to, but he says to me "In revolution, it is the weakest who sacrifice the most. You've done your part, that I might do mine." And then he hands me a nutrient canister or a part I can use. It's nice and all, but why's he looks so sad about it?
en.name: Legs Mem Fragment 3/5

zh.description: 在我出事后……盘总先生对我非常好。总会给我带些东西过来。我跟他说过不必这样，但他对我说："在行动中，弱者牺牲得最多。你尽了你的本分，我也该尽尽我的。" 说完他就递给我一个营养罐头或者一个我能使用的部件。虽然现在一切都已经很好了，但他为什么看起来这么伤心呢？
zh.name: 长腿的记忆碎片 3/5

en.description: Mister The Business got me thinkin': me and my MOAs, we're tight. I need it, they do it. If Nef does try musclin' the Solaris out with his MOAs again… I might just replace his with some of my own. Get inside his head, chek? I mean, I'd rather be gettin' my music to the people, but who says I can't also be a beautiful spider at the center of a big ol' web of subterfuge and intrigue?
en.name: Legs Mem Fragment 4/5

zh.description: 可以说是生意人先生让我真正开始思考：我和我的恐鸟宠物，关系紧密。我需要帮助，它们就给我帮助。如果奈富再用他的恐鸟宠物打击索拉里斯…我也许会用我自己的恐鸟宠物来替换他的。想敲开他的脑袋看看？我是说，我很愿意跟大家分享我的音乐，但谁说我不能同时成为活在巨型诡计阴谋之网中心的美丽的蜘蛛呢？
zh.name: 长腿的记忆碎片 4/5

en.description: I was hangin' in my rack the other cycle, ‘bout to power down, an' I hear Boon and Roky and the venters bangin' skeg on the pipes and ducts. They had a good bounce goin' so's I start singin', as I do. Got a little loud, and the skeg stops. I get all quiet like. Really stepped in it, thinks me. Then the grill pops and Boon's got his head in my hab sayin' "Keep it goin'!" Didn't sleep much that night. Neighbors neither.
en.name: Legs Mem Fragment 5/5

zh.description: 有一天，我挂在自己的床架上，正准备关机休息，然后我就听到阿布和小洛以及其他的通风小子在管道上敲奏管道乐。他们奏得起劲，所以我开始唱起来了。我唱得有点大声，结果管道乐就突然停止了。我以为自己刚才的举动冒犯到他们了，所以吓得不敢发声。随后，铁栅格突然打开了，阿布把头探进我的房间，说道："嘿，继续呀！"结果那一晚我都没怎么睡。邻居们也没睡。通风小子。那就是我。
zh.name: 长腿的记忆碎片 5/5

en.description:
Quills wanted me sellin' arms to the Tenno. Back in Fortuna. Not bloody likely. Quills. Shady, side-mouthed, doubletalking ambidexter-feeling muckers. Never trust anyone who don't speak plain. Told ‘em thanks but hop it. 

I'd a previous commitment: a contract to extract a Corpus defector name of Jubb Lott. 

Quill smiled that smile. The smile I hate the most. The smile of a body who thinks ‘e's two steps ahead.

The more I think about it, the more I know he was.

Pratoo. That was his name. Quill Pratoo Secondary sahd.
en.name: Little Duck's Mem Fragment 1/5

zh.description:
夜羽希望我向天诺出售武器。回到福尔图娜。应该没有血腥。夜羽。阴沉，装腔作势，心怀不轨的伙计。永远不要相信任何不说话的人。告诉他们谢谢，叫他们离开吧。

我之前的承诺是：从一个科普斯叛逃者名字 Jubb Lott 那里得到情报的合同。

夜羽笑了笑。一个我最讨厌的笑容。他总是可以巧妙地预测别人会做什么或想什么。

我想的越多，我就越了解他。

普拉图。那是他的名字。夜羽 普拉图 Secondary sahd。
zh.name: 小鸭子的记忆碎片 1/5

en.description:
JUBB LOTT: Today?! I didn't know you were coming today! 
LITTLE DUCK: That's how hostile extractions typically work, Jubb! (blam) Unless! (blam) you'd like! (blam) to pencil me in! (blam) for a two-thirty next week! (blam) Maybe copy in your supervisor and half the security team?
JUBB LOTT: AAGH! 
LITTLE DUCK: What is their problem?!
JUBB LOTT: I MEAN ALL MY FILES ARE STILL IN MY OFFICE! YOU KNOW: THE WHOLE REASON YOU'RE DOING THIS?
LITTLE DUCK: What files? I wasn't told about any files! 
JUBB LOTT: That's because I didn't tell them!
LITTLE DUCK: Tell who? Tell who, Jubb!
JUBB LOTT: The Quills, alright? The Quills!

And that's when it all made a cruddy kind of mucking sense. I'd been set up.
en.name: Little Duck's Mem Fragment 2/5

zh.description:
JUBB LOTT：今天？！我不知道你今天要来！
小鸭子：这就是敌方撤离点典型的工作，Jubb！（责备）除非！（责备）你想要的！（责备）安排我去！（责备）下周两点半！（责备）也许伪装成你的主管和一半是安全团队？
JUBB LOTT：啊！
小鸭子：他们到底有什么问题？！
JUBB LOTT：我的所有文件都在我的办公室里！你知道吗：你做这件事的原因是什么？
小鸭子：什么文件？我没有被告知什么文件！
JUBB LOTT：那是因为我没告诉他们！
小鸭子：告诉谁？到底是告诉谁，Jubb！
JUBB LOTT：夜羽，了解了吗？就是夜羽！

从那时候开始，这一切都成了一种肮脏污秽的感觉。我被陷害了。
zh.name: 小鸭子的记忆碎片 2/5

en.description:
It was hairy but I managed to get us behind a sealed bulkhead, and into Lott's office. 

LITTLE DUCK: They don't fight like this for mid-level pencilnecks! Who are you?
JUBB LOTT: Jubb. Lott. Secondary Sub-Architect of Nef Anyo's Venusian Restoration. I… have information.

And then he said it.

JUBB LOTT: For Solaris United.

And then he got killed.

JUBB LOTT: Unf!
en.name: Little Duck's Mem Fragment 3/5

zh.description:
状况不明，但我设法把我们带到一个密封的舱壁后面，然后进入 Lott 的办公室。

小鸭子：他们不会这么弱地作战！你是谁？
JUBB LOTT：Jubb。Lott。奈富·安尤的金星修复站的副建筑师。我……有情报。

然后他说了。

JUBB LOTT：关于索拉里斯联盟。

然后他就被杀了。

JUBB LOTT：呃！
zh.name: 小鸭子的记忆碎片 3/5

en.description:
So. Solaris United was on its feet again. I've got friends in Fortuna.  The first time SU tried to knock the crown off Nef's head it almost got every last one of them killed. Some of them, it did. Biz once told me how he survives atrocity. ‘If there's a fire on Deck 12, you seal off Deck 12. You don't go in. That's how you burn up. You wait ‘til the fire's starved of oxygen. That's when you go in, assess the damage and clean up. 'I can't seal off Deck 12. Deck 12 is where I live.

LITTLE DUCK: What information? Tell me! Now!
JUBB LOTT: Nef. Vallis. Orb Mothers…  It's been developed…
LITTLE DUCK: What? What's been developed?!
JUBB LOTT: Shielding... Satellites... The Orb Mothers… cannot be…
LITTLE DUCK: Jubb? What? The Orb Mothers cannot be what? Jubb!
en.name: Little Duck's Mem Fragment 4/5

zh.description:
所以。索拉里斯联盟重新站起来了。我有些朋友在福尔图娜。当索联第一次尝试颠覆奈富的统治时，他们几乎全军覆没。而且，对某些幸存者来说，索联已经死了。Biz 曾跟我讲述他是如何在那场灾难中活下来的："如果12号甲板着火了，你就得封锁12号甲板。你不能进去，因为进去就会被烧死。你只能等火焰把氧气耗尽，才能进去。而接下来要做的，就是评估损伤和清理现场。"封锁12号甲板这种事，我实在是做不到。12号甲板是我生活的地方。

小鸭子：什么情报？告诉我！立刻！
JUBB LOTT：奈富。山谷。圆蛛母亲……已被开发出来了……
小鸭子：什么？什么被开发了？！
JUBB LOTT：护盾……卫星……圆蛛母亲……不能……
小鸭子：Jubb？什么？那些圆蛛母亲不能什么？Jubb！
zh.name: 小鸭子的记忆碎片 4/5

en.description:
Biz saved me from a life of swabbing latrines on Phobos. He made me what I am. But only because I left before I became what he was. 

Now… now I had to go back. Everything Jubb knew… Biz had to know. Yoodi had to know. They, and everyone in Fortuna, could be proper beached if I didn't. Pencilnecks like Jubb don't risk their hide unless they mean it. Whatever Nef was doin' with those Orb Mothers would be a hammer on the head of SU. Had to go back. If I didn't, if somethin' happened to Fortuna, I'd never sleep proper again.

So. No more treasure hunting for LD. No more rescues. Back to where it all happened, and the hope that this time it wasn't burning, and me along with it.
en.name: Little Duck's Mem Fragment 5/5

zh.description:
生意人拯救了我，免了我在火卫一洗擦厕所的人生。他成就了我。但纯粹是因为我在变成他之前就离开了。

现在…现在我要回去了。任何朱布知道的事…生意人都必须要知道。尤迪科也需知道。他们，和每一个在福尔图娜的人，要是我不回去就会被搁浅了。弱鸡如朱布不会拿他们的隐身一事来冒险，除非他们真想这样做。无论那时奈富通过圆蛛母做什么，对索联来说都是一记当头棒喝。要是我不回去，若然福尔图娜出了什么事，我也永远无法安睡了。

所以，小鸭子不需再寻宝。不再有更多的救援。就回到这一切发生的原点，还有那份这次它不会毁于一旦的希冀，包括我在内。
zh.name: 小鸭子的记忆碎片 5/5

en.description: Chatter wakes me, tells me a woman is at my lock, asking for water. Her carapace is scorched. Her raiments, burnt. I fetch water. When I return there are five more women. All singed. They say they are from... Deck 12.
en.name: Rude Zuud's Mem Fragment 1/5

zh.description: 大嘴巴叫醒了我，告诉我有一位女士在我的门口讨水喝。她的外壳被烧焦了。她的外衣也被烧坏了。我转身去取水，当我回来后，门口又多了五位女士。每个都被烧焦了。她们都说她们来自……12号甲板。
zh.name: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片 1/5

en.description: There is no Deck 12. I am certain I have seen those faces before. I fetch more water. I return, they are gone. I return to my rack, feeling… I return to my rack angry at the inconvenience is what I do!
en.name: Rude Zuud's Mem Fragment 2/5

zh.description: 没有12号甲板这个地方。我确定我以前见过这些面孔。我转身去取更多的水。等我回来后，她们就不见了。我回到我的床架上，感觉……我回到我的床架上，为这一通烦心事而气愤不已！
zh.name: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片 2/5

en.description: The gentleman Business visited with me. Inconvenient. Why? Why so much talk when there is so much to do? The gentleman Business communicated the belief that… such nonsense… that I must ‘make peace with what happened on Deck 12.'
en.name: Rude Zuud's Mem Fragment 3/5

zh.description: 生意人绅士拜访过我。真麻烦。谈话有什么意思？明明有这么多活要干，哪有功夫说话？商务绅士给我传达了一种信念那就是……一堆废话……说什么我需要"放下12号甲板上发生的事"。
zh.name: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片 3/5

en.description: Deck 12.  Deck 12. What is this Deck 12. Chatter had stopped speaking entirely, then. "It's all right that you weren't there, Zuud. That's what your visitors wanted you to know. That fire was not for y…" Ach! Enough! Nonsense and stupidity and a waste of my time!
en.name: Rude Zuud's Mem Fragment 4/5

zh.description: 12号甲板。12号甲板。什么是这个12号甲板。之后就完全没再说话了。"你不在那里并不是你的错，祖德。那些来看望你的人就是想让你明白这一点。那场火不是因为你……"啊！够了！无聊！愚蠢！真是浪费我的时间！
zh.name: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片 4/5

en.description:
So many visitors, every one of them hoping to take something away. Dealing with them is like an  uncomfortable dream, while speaking with Chatter is like being shaken awake. Are they real? How real are you, when you're sleeping? How real are you, floating, dreaming you are somewhere else? That's what Chatter wants to know.

How did the women at my lock know my name?
en.name: Rude Zuud's Mem Fragment 5/5

zh.description:
这么多访客，每个都想带走点什么。和他们交涉就像一场令人不适的梦，然而和大嘴巴对话就像被摇醒一样。他们是真实的吗？当你在睡觉的时候，你又有多真实？当你在梦中漂浮着、想象着自己在别的地方的时候，你又有多真实？那些就是大嘴巴想要知道的。

那些在门外的女士们是怎么知道我的名字的？
zh.name: 粗鲁的祖德的记忆碎片 5/5

en.description: I… have no truck with the Corpus. The greatest damage done by avarice for the sake of avarice is precisely that it, without remorse or relent, demonstrates the easy sale of men and women who lend their bodies, their intellects, their voice... to ends in which they themselves do not believe. The Temple of Profit is an ideology that teaches one thing only: that all creations of the mind; words, images and ideas, are meaningless.
en.name: Smokefinger's Mem Fragment 1/5

zh.description: 我……与科普斯之间没有任何恩怨。为了贪婪而贪婪，这种行为所造成的最恶劣的后果，就是它以毫无悔恨和怜悯的方式展现出了一个事实：人们可以轻而易举地借出他们的身体、他们的智慧、他们的声音……为的是连他们自己都不相信的最终目的。润盈殿是一种思想，它只教导一件事：那就是所有头脑的创作；言词，影像，和构想，都是毫无意义的。
zh.name: 黑指头的记忆碎片 1/5

en.description:
And that is how you keep people beaten. By starving them not only of models of something better, but draining them of wholesome inspiration, denying them examples of a higher way of being and sapping them of any belief that they can achieve it.

To be blunt: to Hell with the Corpus. 

Although… although there was one Corpus, a singular man, for whom I make a singular exception. His name was Sigor Savah.
en.name: Smokefinger's Mem Fragment 2/5

zh.description:
而那正是让人们一蹶不振的方法。让他们没有更好的目标可以去追求，消耗他们心中所有的动力，杜绝能让他们接触到高质量生活的机会，同时削弱任何他们认为能达成它的信念。

直言不讳地来说：科普斯都见鬼去吧。

不过……还是有一位特别的科普斯，一个独一无二​​的男人，在我眼中只有他是个例外。他的名字叫西格尔·萨瓦。
zh.name: 黑指头的记忆碎片 2/5

en.description: I was a younger man then, an assistant to the efforts of Morphology Specialist Sigor Savah, though I don't think he ever knew my name. Morphology Specialist Savah's job was to catalog and assess whatever lifeforms - dead or alive - were uncovered as Venus sprang back to life. That man sacrificed everything - career, future, perhaps even his life - to save a kavat, if you can believe that. I know, because I helped him. Though he never knew that, either.
en.name: Smokefinger's Mem Fragment 3/5

zh.description: 在我年轻的时候，曾经当过形态学专家西格尔·萨瓦的助手，虽然我不认为他知道我叫什么名字。形态学专家西格尔·萨瓦的工作是记载和评估金星复苏后被发现的任何生物（无论生死）。你可能不敢相信，那个男人为了拯救一只库娃而牺牲了一切（事业、未来、或许连同他自己的生命）。我知道这件事，因为我曾帮助过他。虽然他也从来没有意识到这一点。
zh.name: 黑指头的记忆碎片 3/5

en.description:
The kavat, Specimen VK-7, had been tracked to her lair and was to be destroyed. Sigor prevented that at the cost of his liberty, and was soon to lose his life. Coward that I was I told myself there was nothing I could do.

Then she was there. VK-7. In front of my hab, waiting, looking at me with more intelligence than any kavat should have. And she dropped keys at my feet. The keys to the security center.

It was I who opened the door to Sigor's cell. Who watched as VK-7 dispatched Sigor's would-be executioner, a Corpus I had often worked with in Reclamation 3. It was I who ensured one cargo pod in particular was replotted, to intercept an outbound Solaris rail tractor. It was I who sealed multiple bulkheads, to stem the flow of troopers meaning to end them both.
en.name: Smokefinger's Mem Fragment 4/5

zh.description:
库娃，样本 VK-7，已被追踪至她的巢穴中，并且即将遭到消灭。西格以他的自由为代价防止了这件事，并且也即将因此失去生命。那时的我，就像一个胆小鬼，只会用"我什么都做不了"的借口来安慰自己。

然后她就出现在了那里。VK-7。就在我的住处前。她看着我，眼中透露出了比任何库娃都要高级的智慧。随后，她就在我的脚前面放了一把钥匙。那是通往安全中心的钥匙。

打开西格牢房门的是我。我看着 VK-7 解决了那个即将对西格行刑的人（一个经常和我一起在3号回收单位工作的科普斯）。是我给一架特定的货舱重新规划了航线，使其阻截了一架离港的索拉里斯航道牵引机。是我封锁了数个舱壁来防止前来拿下他们的士兵们的涌入。
zh.name: 黑指头的记忆碎片 4/5

en.description:
Why did I do it? Hmm.

I remember Sigor best this way: he puts down an instrument, respects me enough to look me in the eye, and he tells me: "Every living thing longs to be whole. Every living thing yearns to defy death. If from death you returned, yet the part you loved best did not… what then?" That was the last thing he ever said to me.

That is why I helped him. In saving that animal Sigor Savah had saved himself. How many of us can say that? I was not about to stand by and let the Corpus steal from him the one thing that was truly his. 

To a flaming Hell with the bloody Corpus.

Cetus, is where Sigor went. The Plains. His story is out there, if you want to hear it. To this day I hope he is, too.
en.name: Smokefinger's Mem Fragment 5/5

zh.description: 我当然不信任她。为什么不？唔……她是一个灵煞！我已经告诉过你了……不。不！我当时对这一切毫不知情，不是吗？我们那时相信是因为奥罗金让我们那样做。毕竟，那是战争。它定义了我们。我们被造成只会去恨，却不会思索为什么要恨。哈。没有。没有假期。嗯……我猜是土星，也许？我一直想近距离看看它的大环……
zh.name: 黑指头的记忆碎片 5/5

en.description: In this life a person has to find that which is more important than themselves. The Orb Vallis died a long time ago. It should not exist. But here it is. It has a second chance. If that's not hope, then what is? I respect anything... that fights its way back from death.
en.name: The Business' Mem Fragment 1/5

zh.description: 人在一生中需要找到比他们自己还重要的东西。奥布山谷在很久以前就已经死去。它本不应该存在。但是现在它就在这里。它有了第二次机会。若那不是希望，那什么是？我尊重任何……与死亡抗争后存活下来的东西。
zh.name: 生意人的记忆碎片 1/5

en.description: A sculptor sees the shape within the rock. Their skill lies in removing anything that is not that shape, delivering something beautiful and lasting into the world.
en.name: The Business' Mem Fragment 2/5

zh.description: 雕刻师在创作前就已经能看到作品在原石内的形状。他们的技巧在于移除不属于那个形状的部分，并将某些美好与永恒的东西带到这个世界。
zh.name: 生意人的记忆碎片 2/5

en.description: I was a sculptor, of sorts. Modest. My task was the considered removal of those who obscured the shape of what we wanted to be. With their deletion a just society came into clearer focus.
en.name: The Business' Mem Fragment 3/5

zh.description: 在某种意义上说，我也曾是一名雕刻师，一名谦卑的雕刻师。我的任务是谨慎移除那些阻碍我们展现自我形态的人。当这些人消失后，社会就能显得更加公正。
zh.name: 生意人的记忆碎片 3/5

en.description:
Small actions lead to powerful outcomes. One example: a young man is repoed, and Eudico resurrects the resistance.

Wise conservation is all about understanding… patterns. Cause and effect. When orchestrating change in an ecosystem, ask: how will the system reconfigure in response to this new species. New forests? Redirected rivers? Diverse and beneficial new breeds? It is all connected.
en.name: The Business' Mem Fragment 4/5

zh.description:
微小的举动可以引发重大的结果。举个例子：一名年轻人被执行索回，却导致尤迪科恢复了反抗之声。

明智的动物保育活动，必须基于对事物运行规律的理解之上。因与果。当你对生态系统进行调整时，试着问自己这样的问题：系统将会以什么样的方式​来应对这个全新的物种。新的森林？河流改道？多样且有益的新品种？一切都是相互关联的。
zh.name: 生意人的记忆碎片 4/5

en.description:
It was Legs' punishment that inspired Eudico to resurrect Solaris United. Lean and wise, it is time for that hungry, furious wolf to enter the woods. For the Corpus to receive a selective and beneficial extinction.

A small price to pay. A young man's body. An old man's soul.
en.name: The Business' Mem Fragment 5/5

zh.description: 腿哥所受的惩罚激发了尤迪科重建索拉里斯联盟的决心。事态的发展就是如此巧妙，是时候让那头饥饿且狂怒的狼进入树林了。科普斯将会迎来有选择性且对整个系统有益的灭绝。为此付出的，只是一个小小的代价。一位年轻人的身体。和一位老者的灵魂。
zh.name: 生意人的记忆碎片 5/5

en.description: Used to be every time an old love ended and a new one began, friends would say "You seem so much happier now." And I'd smile and I'd agree and then I'd go back to my hab... and say your name. Just to feel it on my lips again. Like summoning a ghost.
en.name: Ticker's Mem Fragment 1/5

zh.description: 按照以往的规律，每当一场旧爱结束时，新的爱情就会开始，朋友们都会说"你现在看起来更快乐了"。我会表示赞同并还以微笑，然后在回到我的住处之后……说出你的名字。这只是为了能让我的双唇再次感受它。就像召唤幽灵一样。
zh.name: 报价员的记忆碎片 1/5

en.description:
We met in unspoken agreement. You called me by the name of the one who had hurt you. My name for you was the name of the one who had wounded me. We played  the part for each other. When I spoke, I spoke for them. Through you I told the one who had wounded me all the little things I never had the chance to. Cooked them all the meals I never got to share. Made all the jokes. Laughed all the laughs. With them, through you. And you, with yours, through me.

Then, one day, you called me by my own name and we never looked back.
en.name: Ticker's Mem Fragment 2/5

zh.description:
我们的会面带着一种默契。你用那位伤害你的人的名字称呼我。而我则给你冠上了那个伤害了我的人的名字。我们相互为对方扮演对方所需要的角色。我所说的话，都是在为那些角色而说。通过你，我把那些一直以来都没有机会说出的小事情全都告诉那个伤害了我的人。所有那些为他们烹调而我却无法享用的菜肴，所有那些玩笑，所有那些欢声笑语。我通过我的那些角色来面对你，而你，则用你的那些角色来面对我。

然后，有一天，你用了我自己的名字叫我，我们从此不再回首。
zh.name: 报价员的记忆碎片 2/5

en.description:
There's a dream I have every now and then. You are you, in your own first body. And I am there in mine. I stand on the shore. You stand in the sea. I watch as the waves roll in, but never break against your back. They whisper right through you, and you fade away from me. Again.

I still have your glove. Just the one. The only thing I have left of you. In quiet moments I lay it on my lap, lace my fingers through yours, and make promises.

I promised that what happened to you would never happen to another.

Promises. I couldn't keep.
en.name: Ticker's Mem Fragment 3/5

zh.description:
我不时会做一场梦。你是你，在你的第一个身躯里。且我在我的身躯里。我站在海岸上。你站在海里。我看着海浪滚进来，可是它们不会打到你的背。它们从背后低调穿过你，并且你从我前面消失。再一次。

我仍有你的手套。只有这个。这是我唯一留下关于你的东西。在安静的时候我会把它放在我的大腿上，然后假装与你十指相扣，并许下诺言。

我承诺，在你身上发生的事再也不会发生在另外一个人的身上。

而这，是我过去没能遵守的诺言。
zh.name: 报价员的记忆碎片 3/5

en.description:
I sold my arms to buy you an arm. I sold my legs to buy you a leg. I sold my lungs, my bones, my heart... to buy a safe place to cradle your beautiful head. I bought you back from them. I brought you back to me. You in the body I had bought for you, me in the body I had earned to replace the one I sold. 

But you weren't you. Not anymore.
en.name: Ticker's Mem Fragment 4/5

zh.description:
我卖掉了我的手臂来为你买一只手臂。我卖掉了我的脚来为你买一只脚。我卖掉了我的肺、我的骨头、我的心……来买下一个安放你美丽头部的安全摇蓝。我从他们那里把你买回来了。我把你带回来我身边。你在一副我买给你的身躯内，我在一个我用自己的身体换来的身躯内。

但你已不再是你。再也不是了。
zh.name: 报价员的记忆碎片 4/5

en.description:
Sat so long on the Taxman's shelf, you barely knew who you were. And you certainly didn't know me. 

The goodbyes I said decades earlier… they stuck. 

These days you work the canal with few memories of who you were. And I'm in the business of keeping promises.
en.name: Ticker's Mem Fragment 5/5

zh.description:
搁置在税务官的架上，你几乎不认得你自己了。而且你当然也不认得我了。

几十年前说过的再见……仍会共鸣。

这些天你在运河里工作，仅存几个关于自己是谁的记忆。然后我还蛮擅长守住承诺的。
zh.name: 报价员的记忆碎片 5/5

en.description: On the heels of the Tenno's victory against the Sentients, the end of the Old War, the golden structures of Orokin civilization collapsed. The absolute cause of this ruination is unknown, but speculation has pointed to natural disaster, political uprising and universal warfare as potential agents of cataclysm. Archived details for this event have never been recovered.
en.name: The Collapse

zh.description: 随着天诺对抗灵煞的胜利，即远古之战的终结，奥罗金文明的完美金色架构崩塌了。毁灭的主要的原因仍然不明确，但是猜测指出，自然灾害、政治暴乱和宇宙间的战争是造成灾难的潜在因素。这次事件的文献细节从未被恢复过。
zh.name: 大毁灭

en.description: Submerged deep below Uranus' oceanic surface, and hidden from prying eyes, is a research facility for cloning and reproduction. Water pressure at these extreme depths put massive strain on the glass and steel structures housing these operations, but as freshly sprung leaks remind of the impending crushing force surrounding them, the Grineer forge ahead with their experiments.
en.name: Uranus

zh.description: 潜藏于天王星海境深处、避过众多猎食者眼线的是专职基因复制与繁殖的研究设施。位于极深海底，容纳着这些工程的钢铁与玻璃建筑承载着奇大水压，但就在新增的绽裂提醒着他们迫在眉睫的碾压巨力之时，克隆尼潜心投入在他们的研究之中、突飞猛进。
zh.name: 天王星

en.description: Hidden and entrenched in the mountainous peaks of Venus, the Corpus practice their industrious craft. The superstructures built here are a testament to the inventive Corpus engineers that have settled in regions where lingering Orokin technology still moderates surface temperatures.
en.name: Venus

zh.description: 深藏盘踞在金星那绵延山峰之中的科普斯商会，勤勉地从事着他们的行业。竖立此的宏伟建筑证明了驻扎该处的科普斯工程师所富有的创造力，而这里残存的奥罗金科技仍然在调节着地表的温度
zh.name: 金星

en.description: Originally we studied Void occurrences from afar, observing and cataloguing the distribution of galaxies and refining cosmological evolution models. We are in a new age of cosmic exploration. Advancements in space travel partnered with determined curiosity have brought us closer to our object of study, and with it, revelation.
en.name: Void

zh.description: 起初，我等远远地观研虚空的出现，观察并纪录星系的分布，进而完善宇宙演化模型。此时我等正处于宇宙探索的新纪元。星际航行技术的进步，配以坚定的好奇心，令我们与研究对象更近了一步，随之而来的，便是启示。
zh.name: 虚空

en.description: A mysterious weaponized armor controlled solely by the Tenno. Through the Warframe, Tenno can cheat death, channel the forbidden Void energies and face scores of enemies without fatigue. Due to apparent resistances of their Bio-Metal exoskeletons, Warframes can be safely deployed to Infestation Outbreaks, should they occur. In-depth information of the Warframe mandate is forbidden to all but the Seven.
en.name: Warframe Technology

zh.description: 一具神秘、武装化的盔甲，由天诺战士单独控制。通过战甲，天诺战士得以欺骗死亡，导引那禁忌的虚空能量，同时对抗成群的敌人而不见疲倦。由于他们生化金属外骨骼的各种对外抗击能力，当需要时，战甲得以安全地投入对抗的感染者爆发。关于战甲授权的深入信息除了七人众之外皆禁止触及。
zh.name: 战甲科技

en.description: The true nature of the Warframes and their Tenno connection is a secret lost to the Old War. Together, they represent our best hope in turning the tide of the machine war. Warframes are unique from Dax and other Infantry, deploying dangerous and esoteric Void energy and equipped with often mundane physical weapons – this is key to fighting an enemy that had turned our technology against us.
en.name: Warframes

zh.description: 战甲的真实本质以及其与天诺战士的关联，皆是在远古之战中所遗忘的秘密。两者合二为一，代表着在这机械战争中力挽狂澜的最大希望。战甲独特而有別于禁卫以及其他战旅，搭载着致命而奥妙的虚空能量，并且大多装配着平凡的物理武器─这是反击那些让我们的科技倒戈的敌人的关键。
zh.name: 战甲

en.description: Most of the wildlife observed today can be traced back to creatures of Earth. In the Orokin age, organic manipulation was used to modify earth lifeforms to a purpose: war, agriculture, pets. Long after their Orokin masters perished, some of these species managed to survive through adaptation, and can be found roaming in natural environments.
en.name: Wildlife

zh.description: 现今所知绝大部分的野生生物皆可追溯至地球的生物。远在奥罗金时代，常为了一些目的而运用基因工程技术调整地球的各种生物：战争、农业，以及作为宠物。在它们的奥罗金主人凋零良久之后，这些物种之中有些适应了环境而得以生存，并可发现它们自在徜徉于自然环境之中。
zh.name: 野生动物

en.description: A key that grants access to missions within the Void
en.name: Orokin Void Key

zh.description: 一个可让你进入虚空的钥匙
zh.name: 奥罗金虚空钥匙

en.description:
My Queens, you were right, the Tenno threat is real. We found one drifting near Earth but the Lotus knew we were coming. She purged the Cryo moments before we had them and sent a squad of Tenno to break our assault.

They escaped. We are working on tracing them. Separate this Tenno from the flock and it should be easy to kill. We shattered its Warframe and expect such an abrupt Cryo purge will have damaged its memories.

We anxiously await punishment for failing this task.

- VOR

zh.description:
我尊敬的女皇们——

你们是正确的，天诺的威胁千真万确。我们找到一个天诺漂浮在地球附近，但莲事先料到了我们的行动。就在我们要抓住天诺之前，莲解除了冷冻睡眠，并派来一支天诺小队破坏了我们的攻势。

他们逃跑了。我们正在追踪。只要将这个天诺与大部队分开，就应该很容易干掉。我们已经击碎了其战甲外甲，并且如此突然地解除冷冻将对其记忆力造成损伤。

由于未能完成任务，我们不胜惶恐地等待应得的惩罚。

——沃尔
